body:
Santiago saw the shark’s jaws ⓐopening and closing in anticipation. He knew this shark no longer cared about the dangers of a boat or of a fisherman. The smell of blood took away the shark’s fear, making it brave and reckless. Santiago didn’t have much rope left over from tying up the marlin, but he tightened the short remaining piece of rope into a knot on his spear. The shark got closer and closer, mouth open and teeth shining in the sunlight.
Santiago’s mind felt strong and clear, his willpower ⓑwas restored. The spear wasn’t very long, too short to hit the shark before it arrived at the marlin. Still, Santiago refused to give up. The shark’s eyes flashed and he bit the beautiful fish just above the tail. It ripped and bit and ⓒtook a huge piece of meat — at least 40 pounds — out of the giant marlin.
The old man could hear the marlin’s skin tearing and bones breaking as he drove the spear into the shark’s head. He pushed the weapon in right behind the eyes and above the neck, ⓓwhich the brain was. It turned over, and he could see the shark’s eyes rolling in its head. It hit the water with its tail and turned the ocean water white with its struggling.
Santiago tried to get his spear out, but couldn’t. He ⓔhad cast the spear too deep into the shark’s body, and the rope was too short. Even though its body struggled, the shark was already dead. After a moment, it ⓕlaid still on the surface before sinking slowly into the water, taking the spear with it.
윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ 중, 어법상 어색한 것을 모두 골라 짝지은 것은?
solution: ⓑ was restored → restored ⓓ which → where ⓕ laid → lay

body:
So much of the marlin’s blood flowed into the water from where it ⓐhad been bitten. Santiago knew more sharks would come before long. He had no spear, and his boat was still many miles from the land. The fisherman knew he would fail, understanding ⓑwhat he had no hope of protecting the beautiful marlin. Santiago didn’t care. He would struggle as long as possible, even if he could not succeed.
“A man can ⓒdestroy,” he said. “But not defeated.”
Santiago turned back to his boat and looked at the great fish. The shark had ruined the marlin’s powerful tail and made it so ugly ⓓthat it hurt Santiago’s spirit whenever he looked at its ⓔtorn flesh. Santiago felt sorry for catching the marlin and wanted to apologize to the beautiful animal.
윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것을 모두 고르면?
solution: ⓑ what → that ⓒ destroy → be destroyed

The old man could hear the marlin’s skin tearing and bones breaking as he drove the spear into the shark’s head. He pushed the weapon in right behind the eyes and above the neck, where the brain was. It turned over, and he could see the shark’s eyes rolling in its head. It hit the water with its tail and turned the ocean water white with its struggling.
Santiago tried to get his spear out, but couldn’t. He had cast the spear too deep into the shark’s body, and the rope was too short. Even though its body struggled, the shark was already dead. After a moment, it lay still on the surface before sinking slowly into the water, taking the spear with it.

So much of the marlin’s blood flowed into the water from where it had (A)bitten. Santiago knew ⓐ______. He had no spear, and his boat was still many miles from the land. The fisherman knew he would fail, (B)understood that he had no hope of protecting the beautiful marlin. Santiago didn’t care. He would struggle (C)as long as he could, even if he could not succeed.
“A man can be destroyed,” he said. “But not defeated.”
Santiago turned back to his boat and looked at the great fish. The shark had ruined the marlin’s powerful tail and made it (D)so ugly it hurt Santiago’s spirit (E)whenever he looked at its torn flesh. Santiago felt sorry for catching the marlin and wanted to apologize to the beautiful animal.
윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)~(E)에 대한 설명으로 알맞지 않은 것은?
choices: (A): 주어 it은 ‘물렸던’ 대상이므로, 과거완료 수동태가 되도록 been bitten으로 고쳐야 한다.
(B): 분사구문을 이루는 분사 자리이며, 의미상 주어인 The fisherman이 ‘이해하는’ 주체이므로 현재분사 understanding으로 고쳐야 한다.
(C): ‘가능한 오래’라는 뜻으로 as long as possible로 바꾸어 쓸 수 있다.
(D): 과거형 동사 made의 목적격보어 자리에서 ‘so+형용사+that절(너무 ~해서 …한)’ 구문을 이루고 있다.
(E): 부사절을 이끄는 접속사로 no matter when으로 바꾸어 쓸 수 있다.
solution:
(E) whenever가 부사절을 이끄는 접속사라는 설명은 알맞으나, whenever는 ‘~할 때마다’라는 뜻의 시간의 접속사로 쓰였으므로 every time 등으로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다. 참고로, whenever가 ‘언제 ~하더라도’라는 뜻의 양보의 의미로 쓰일 때는 no matter when으로 바꾸어 쓸 수 있다.
오답
(A) 관계부사 where가 이끄는 절의 주어 it(= the marlin)이 타동사 bite(~을 물다)의 대상이며 뒤에 이어진 목적어가 없으므로, had에 이어져 과거완료 수동태(had+been+p.p.)를 이루는 been bitten으로 고쳐야 한다는 설명은 적절하다.

Are you keen on exploring the world of literature? Is reading your hobby? Here’s an exciting type of event — literary festivals! These events are ⓐhosted in cities with rich literary histories, connecting authors and readers. Take a glance at these festivals across different regions!
Edinburgh International Book Festival
Where: Edinburgh, Scotland
The Edinburgh International Book Festival happens every year in Edinburgh, ⓑwhich was designated the first UNESCO City of Literature. The festival is one of the largest literary ⓒevent globally and is typically held in August. It takes place at the University of Edinburgh’s College of Art, ⓓcreating a village atmosphere. There are outdoor screens for live events, making it an engaging experience for all.
Frankfurter Buchmesse
Where: Frankfurt, Germany
The Frankfurter Buchmesse is the world’s largest book fair, drawing together publishers, authors, and book fans from across the globe. It is held for five days in October, with the initial two days usually ⓔreserving for trade visitors and professionals, while the following days are open to the general public. This fair is a must for anybody, speaking any language, ⓕwhich has ambitions in the publishing world or simply loves to read.
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ 중, 어법상 어색한 것의 개수는?
choices: 1개
2개
3개
4개
5개
solution:
어법상 어색한 것은 총 3개이다.
ⓒ event → events (’가장 ~한 것들 중의 하나‘라는 뜻의 ’one of the+최상급+복수명사(구)’ 구문을 이루어야 하므로, 단수명사 event를 복수명사 events로 고친다.)
ⓔ reserving → reserved (전치사 with, 목적어 the initial two days와 함께 ‘~가 …한 상태로[채로]’를 뜻하는 ‘with+명사(구)+분사’ 구문을 이루어야 하며, 명사구인 the initial two days는 ‘지정된’ 대상이므로 reserving은 수동의 의미를 나타내는 과거분사 reserved로 고친다.)
ⓕ which → who 또는 that (주어가 없는 불완전한 절(has ~ read)을 이끄는 주격 관계대명사 자리로, 선행사가 이중콤마(,)로 삽입된 분사구 speaking any language 앞의 anybody이므로, which를 사람이 선행사일 때 사용하는 who 또는 선행사에 관계없이 사용할 수 있는 that으로 고친다.)
*ⓕ는 원래 지문에서 who였음
오답
ⓓ 완전한 절(It takes place at the University of Edinburgh’s College of Art)에 접속사 없이 콤마(,)로만 연결되어 있으며 문맥상 부대상황을 나타내는 분사구문을 이루는 분사 자리이며, 의미상 주어인 it(=The Edinburgh International Book Festival)이 분위기를 ‘만들어내는’ 주체이므로 능동의 의미인 현재분사 creating은 적절하다.

“Don’t think, old man,” he said. “Sail on this course and take it when it comes.”
But he couldn’t stop thinking. Alone on the ocean, with the poor marlin’s blood spilling into the water, all he could do was think. He thought of the great baseball player Joe DiMaggio. He wondered if Joe DiMaggio could have killed the shark without losing the spear. Santiago thought of his own ⓐwounded hands and wondered how Joe DiMaggio could play baseball so well in spite of his own injuries. He wondered if he, like Joe DiMaggio, could ignore the ⓑunbearable pain and fatigue in his body long enough to meet his goals.
“Think about something ⓒdistressing, old man,” he said. “Every minute now you are closer to home. You sail lighter for the loss of 40 pounds.”
However, Santiago knew this was false hope. Too much blood in the water. Too many sharks. Too far from land with these ⓓfierce ocean currents. Still, the fisherman promised he would continue to fight. (A)두려움도 자신의 창을 잃은 것도 그의 결심을 빼앗아갈 수 없었다. He had to come up with a new weapon, removing the rowing oars and attaching his knife to one.
“Now,” he said. “I am still an old man. But I am not unarmed.”
The breeze got stronger and his boat ⓔgained speed. He felt fresh, and his determination returned. The sharks would almost certainly take his beautiful marlin, but Santiago would never cease fighting them. A man can be destroyed, but never defeated.
윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 흐름상 어색한 것은?
solution:
ⓒ distressing(고통스러운) → cheerful(기분 좋은)
본문변형
ⓐ injured(다친) → wounded(상처 입은, 부상당한)
ⓓ strong(강한) → fierce(거센)
ⓔ sped up(속도를 높였다) → gained speed(속도를 높였다)

body:
Santiago saw the shark’s jaws opening and closing in anticipation. He knew this shark no longer cared about the dangers of a boat or of a fisherman. The smell of blood took away the shark’s fear, making it brave and reckless. Santiago didn’t have much rope left over from tying up the marlin, but he tightened the short remaining piece of rope into a knot on his spear. The shark got closer and closer, mouth open and teeth shining in the sunlight.
Santiago’s mind felt strong and clear, his willpower restored. The spear wasn’t very long, too short to hit the shark before it arrived at the marlin. Still, Santiago refused to give up. The shark’s eyes flashed and he bit the beautiful fish just above the tail. It ripped and bit and took a huge piece of meat — at least 40 pounds — out of the giant marlin.
The old man could hear the marlin’s skin tearing and bones breaking as he drove the spear into the shark’s head. He pushed the weapon in right behind the eyes and above the neck, where the brain was. It turned over, and he could see the shark’s eyes rolling in its head. It hit the water with its tail and turned the ocean water white with its struggling.
Santiago tried to get his spear out, but couldn’t. He had cast the spear too deep into the shark’s body, and the rope was too short. Even though its body struggled, the shark was already dead. After a moment, it lay still on the surface before sinking slowly into the water, taking the spear with it.
윗글의 제목으로 알맞은 것은?
choices: Santiago‘s Tough Decision to Give up His Precious Catch
Santiago’s Triumph over the Shark at a Heavy Price
The Shark’s Lucky Escape from Santiago’s Deadly Attack
Santiago‘s Intense Confrontation with a Pack of Merciless Sharks
Santiago: A Fearless Fisherman Who Killed a Shark with His Bare Hands

body:
“Don’t think, old man,” he said. “Sail on this course and take it when it comes.”
But he couldn’t stop thinking. Alone on the ocean, ⓐ불쌍한 청새치의 피가 물속으로 쏟아지는 가운데, 그가 할 수 있는 모든 것은 생각하는 것이었다. He thought of the great baseball player Joe DiMaggio. He wondered if Joe DiMaggio could have killed the shark without losing the spear. Santiago thought of his own injured hands and wondered how Joe DiMaggio could play baseball so well in spite of his own injuries. He wondered if he, like Joe DiMaggio, could ignore the unbearable pain and fatigue in his body long enough to meet his goals.
“Think about something cheerful, old man,” he said. “Every minute now you are closer to home. You sail lighter for the loss of 40 pounds.”
However, Santiago knew this was false hope. Too much blood in the water. Too many sharks. Too far from land with these strong ocean currents. Still, the fisherman promised he would continue to fight. Neither fear nor the loss of his spear could take away his determination. He had to come up with a new weapon, removing the rowing oars and attaching his knife to one.
“Now,” he said. “I am still an old man. But I am not unarmed.”
The breeze got stronger and his boat sped up. He felt fresh, and his determination returned. The sharks would almost certainly take his beautiful marlin, but Santiago would never cease fighting them. A man can be destroyed, but never defeated.
윗글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문은?
choices: What did Santiago find himself unable to stop doing while alone at sea?
What did Santiago wonder about Joe DiMaggio’s ability to play baseball despite his injuries?

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is one of the biggest catch phrases these days. While cutting-edge technology might have ⓐbenefits for many people, it is also a cause of concern for those trying to start a career. With so many jobs disappearing, what kind of career should you pursue, and what skills should you have to survive in the AI age? Whether you like it or hate it, AI technology is probably here to stay. Here are the core ⓑcompetencies you need to foster for a great career in the age of AI.
Before the Internet, people with vast knowledge were considered to be the most talented. Quiz shows with difficult questions, such as the name of the famous stone castle built by Cormac MacCarthy in 1446, used to be very popular. However, things have changed, and now with the ⓒpresence of AI, many people question why one would memorize such information. Unlike in the past, this is because you can quickly find answers on the Internet, and if you want, an AI assistant will even find an answer for you.
In 2011, the 74-time winner of a popular American quiz show competed against a supercomputer. The fact that the computer won a resounding victory shows that humans cannot keep up with computers in finding ⓓfactual information. If that person were to compete with current AI, he would probably lose by a larger margin.
We don’t need to memorize all the answers, and no matter how hard we try, we cannot rival AI in memorizing vast quantities of information. What we need to focus on is obtaining the “right” answers from AI, and the key is to ask the right questions to elicit the answer you want from AI. That is not to say you don’t need to study. We are currently in an era where the ability to use information is more important than having all the details memorized. We must be able to do what AI is not good at rather than focusing on what AI does best.

body:
Strong AI and Weak AI are two fascinating branches of artificial intelligence that capture our imagination. Strong AI, like something from a sci-fi movie, can think, learn, and perform various tasks and cope with various situations just like humans. The current level of AI systems cannot do such things yet. Weak AI, on the other hand, the kind we now encounter daily, focuses on conducting one job well. It can do things such as recommending movies, giving us directions, or even ⓐhelping us pick the perfect songs. However, it outperforms humans only in the specific tasks it is designed for, and it operates under far more constraints than even the most basic human intelligence ⓑis. There are several differences between Weak AI and Strong AI.
What Is Weak AI?
Did you know that the computer playing chess and the helpful voice assistant on your phone are both examples of Weak AI? They may be impressive, but they’re designed for specific tasks and can’t handle anything outside their programming. Weak AI is a category of artificial intelligence ⓒconfined to a finite domain. By performing operations that require considerable time and utilizing methods that are not always accessible to people, this technology can be advantageous to society.
It concentrates on tasks such as responding to user input searches or playing games. While it is only as good as its programming and training, Weak AI still helps ⓓconvert enormous amounts of data into useful information by identifying patterns and generating predictions.
What Is Strong AI?
Strong AI is designed to mimic the cognitive abilities of a human being. It is called “strong” because it has the potential to perform a wide range of tasks, rather than being limited to a specific set of tasks. ⓔThe most an AI system approaches the abilities of a human being, with all our intelligence, emotion, and broad knowledge, the “stronger” the AI system is considered.
One of the key characteristics of Strong AI is that it is designed to learn and ⓕadapt to new situations. It can generalize from its training data and apply its knowledge to new situations. For example, a Strong AI system designed to recognize objects in images can learn to recognize objects it hasn’t seen before based on its previous training. Another key attribute of Strong AI is ⓖthat it is designed to be self-aware and conscious. This means that it can think, reason, and make decisions like a human being. While current AI systems are far from achieving this level of intelligence, some researchers believe that it is possible to create Strong AI in the future.
윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓖ 중, 어법상 어색한 것의 개수는?
choices: 2개
3개

5개
6개

Quiz shows with difficult questions, such as the name of the famous stone castle built by Cormac MacCarthy in 1446, used to ⓐ[be / being] very popular. However, things have changed, and now with the presence of AI, many people question why one would memorize such information. Unlike in the past, this is because you can quickly find answers on the Internet, and if you want, an AI assistant will even find an answer for you.
In 2011, the 74-time winner of a popular American quiz show competed against a supercomputer. The fact ⓑ[that / which] the computer won a resounding victory shows that humans cannot keep up with computers in finding factual information. If that person were to compete with current AI, he would probably lose by a larger margin.
We don’t need to memorize all the answers, and no matter how hard we try, we cannot rival AI in memorizing vast quantities of information. What we need to focus on is obtaining the “right” answers from AI, and the key is to ask the right questions to elicit the answer you want from AI. That is not to say you don’t need to study. To ask the right questions, you must understand the context in which you’re asking the question, and you also need background knowledge on the topic. When AI provides an answer, you must also be able to tell how accurate the answer is. We are currently in an era where the ability to use information is more important than having all the details ⓒ[memorize / memorized]. We must be able to do what AI is not good at rather than focusing on (A)what AI does best.
윗글의 목적으로 알맞은 것은?
choices: to explain why quiz shows lost their popularity after the Internet appeared
to describe how computers outperform humans in finding factual information
to stress that people should improve their memory to compete with AI
to argue that acquiring extensive background knowledge is unnecessary in the age of AI
to inform readers that asking good questions matters more than memorizing information in the AI era
solution: 인터넷 이전에는 방대한 지식을 가진 사람들이 가장 능력 있는 사람들로 여겨졌지만, 인터넷과 인공지능의 등장으로 정보 암기의 중요성이 감소하였으며, 인간은 방대한 양의 정보를 외우는 데 있어서 인공지능에 필적할 수 없다고 한 뒤, 우리가 집중해야 할 것은 인공지능으로부터 ‘올바른’ 답을 얻는 것이고, 그 핵심은 인공지능으로부터 원하는 답을 이끌어내기 위해 올바른 질문을 하는 것이라고 주장하고 있으므로, 글의 목적으로 ❺ ‘인공지능 시대에 정보를 암기하는 것보다 좋은 질문을 하는 것이 더 중요하다는 것을 독자에게 알리기 위해’가 알맞다.

body:
AI can often find the information we want quickly, but there are problems with this. AI creates a lot of false or biased information. Further, AI cannot understand the intentions of the person who created the information, nor (A)does it have the ability to judge whether the information is right or wrong. Moreover, stories of AI (B)providing fake information are often reported. For example, there was a case of a lawyer (C)who submitted non-existent cases made by AI to a real court. There has also been an example of AI recommending restaurants that didn’t exist.
Just as much as misleading information, ⓐ______ causes incorrect or even harmful output. A world-famous Internet company had AI (D)study ten years of employee records to create a new employee selection algorithm. However, the company decided not to use the algorithm when it favored men over women. The proportion of male employees was very high and thus the AI’s machine learning had an underlying bias towards male data. (E)When analyzing the information provided by AI, it is always necessary to assess the quality of information — remember: garbage in, garbage out.
윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)~(E)에 대한 설명으로 알맞지 않은 것은?
choices: (A): 부정어 nor가 절 앞에 쓰였으므로 ‘조동사+주어+동사원형’의 어순으로 도치되었다.
(B): 전치사 of의 목적어 자리에 쓰인 동명사로, 의미상 주어 AI가 목적격 형태로 앞에 위치해 있다.
(C): a lawyer를 선행사로 하는 주격 관계대명사이며, that으로 바꿀 수 있다.
(D): 사역동사 had의 목적격보어 자리이며 목적어 AI가 ‘학습하는’ 주체이므로 능동 관계를 나타내는 동사원형이 쓰였다.
(E): 접속사를 생략하지 않은 분사구문을 이루고 있으며, When it analyzes로 바꿀 수 있다.
solution: (E) 접속사를 생략하지 않은 분사구문이며 ‘접속사+주어+동사’로 바꿀 수 있으나, 주절의 it은 가주어이고, 진주어인 to부정사구(to assess ~ information)의 의미상 주어, 즉 ‘평가하는’ 주체와 부사절의 주어인 ‘분석하는’ 주체가 일반인이므로, it이 아닌 일반 주어(we, you 등)를 사용하여 When we[you] analyze와 같은 형태로 바꿀 수 있다.

body:
It is AI ⓐthat is good at collecting and classifying information. Meanwhile, it is humans that are best at dealing with people. The ability to understand, empathize, and communicate with people emotionally ⓑare potentially the most important human ability that artificial intelligence cannot replace. For example, AI disease diagnostic programs, which are already ⓒused in many hospitals, may accurately diagnose a patient’s illness such as cancer, but they don’t have the human touch ⓓwhat can make eye contact, empathize with pain, share worries, hold hands, or give encouragement to patients in despair. It is human doctors who can cure the patient’s emotional distress. Actually ⓔknowing and caring about what others think and feel is a unique competitive advantage we still possess.
윗글을 아래와 같이 요약할 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 지문에서 찾아 알맞게 쓰시오. (각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓸 것)
While AI is skilled at gathering and categorizing information, it cannot ______ humans’ ability to relate to other people and communicate with them ______, which still gives us a distinctive ______ ______ over AI.
solution: 정답은 replace, emotionally, competitive, advantage 이다. (해설 없음)

body:
The Old Man and the Sea is about an old man called Santiago. Santiago hadn’t caught a fish in 84 days, so people thought he was unlucky, maybe cursed. In order to change his terrible luck, Santiago decided to go out into the deep ocean, far beyond the other fishermen. At first, he only caught a small tuna, but at the end of the 85th day, a powerful, magnificent marlin bit Santiago’s fishing hook. The fish was so strong it dragged Santiago’s boat for three days. Santiago learned to ______, to admire its courage, and to appreciate its beauty. When it finally died, he saw it was too big to put inside the boat. Instead, he tied it to the side of his boat and tried to return home. Unfortunately, a shark smelled the marlin’s blood and threatened to eat Santiago’s prized fish.

윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
choices: think highly of the fish
consider the fish inferior
feel ashamed of his failure
despise his powerful opponent
regard the fish as an unworthy opponent
solution:
85일째 날이 끝날 무렵 Santiago의 낚싯바늘을 문 힘세고 거대한 청새치는 너무 강해서 그의 배를 3일 동안 끌고 다녔다고 했으며, Santiago는 그 용기에 감탄하고, 그 아름다움을 높이 평가하게 되었다는 내용이 이어지므로, Santiago는 청새치의 강인함을 인정하여 존경하게 되었다는 흐름으로 빈칸에는 ① ‘그 물고기를 높이 평가하다[존중하다]’가 알맞다.
본문변형 respect → think highly of
오답
② 그 물고기를 열등하다고 여기다
③ 자신의 실패를 부끄러워하다
④ 자신의 강력한 상대를 경멸하다
⑤ 그 물고기를 상대할 가치가 없는 적수로 여기다

body:
Santiago saw the shark’s jaws opening and closing in anticipation. He knew this shark no longer cared about the dangers of a boat or of a fisherman. The smell of blood took away the shark’s fear, making ⓐit brave and reckless. Santiago didn’t have much rope left over from tying up the marlin, but he tightened the short remaining piece of rope into a knot on his spear. The shark got closer and closer, mouth open and teeth shining in the sunlight.
(A) The old man could hear the marlin’s skin tearing and bones breaking as he drove the spear into the shark’s head. He pushed the weapon in right behind the eyes and above the neck, where the brain was. ⓑIt turned over, and he could see the shark’s eyes rolling in its head. It hit the water with its tail and turned the ocean water white with its struggling.
(B) Santiago tried to get his spear out, but couldn’t. He had cast ⓒit too deep into the shark’s body, and the rope was too short. Even though its body struggled, the shark was already dead. After a moment, ⓓit lay still on the surface before sinking slowly into the water, taking the spear with it.
(C) Santiago’s mind felt strong and clear, his willpower restored. The spear wasn’t very long, too short to hit the shark before it arrived at the marlin. Still, Santiago refused to give up. The shark’s eyes flashed and ⓔhe bit the beautiful fish just above the tail. It ripped and bit and took a huge piece of meat — at least 40 pounds — out of the giant marlin.

위 주어진 글에 이어질 순서로 알맞은 것은?
solution: Santiago는 상어의 턱이 기대에 차서 열리고 닫히는 모습을 보고 남은 짧은 밧줄을 창에 단단히 조여 매듭을 지었으며, 상어가 점점 더 가까워졌다는 주어진 글 다음에, 창이 너무 짧아 상어가 청새치에 도달하기 전에 맞출 수는 없었지만 Santiago는 포기하길 거부했고, 상어는 청새치의 꼬리 바로 위를 물어 적어도 40파운드에 달하는 커다란 고기 조각을 가져갔다는 내용의 (C)가 가장 먼저 온다. 다음으로 Santiago가 창을 상어의 머리에 꽂아 넣으며 청새치의 껍질이 찢어지고 뼈가 부러지는 소리를 들을 수 있었고 상어는 몸을 뒤집고 꼬리로 물을 내리쳤다는 내용의 (A), Santiago는 상어의 몸에 너무 깊숙이 박힌 창을 빼내지 못했고, 이미 죽은 상어는 잠시 후 창과 함께 물속으로 천천히 가라앉았다는 내용의 (B)로 이어지는 것이 알맞다.

(B) He had no spear, and his boat was still many miles from the land. (C) The fisherman knew he would fail, understanding that he had no hope of protecting the beautiful marlin. (D) Realizing that defeat was unavoiable, he decided to surrender without further resistance. (E) Santiago didn’t care. He would struggle as long as he could, even if he could not succeed.
“A man can be destroyed,” he said. “But not defeated.”
Santiago turned back to his boat and looked at the great fish. ⓐ상어는 청새치의 강력한 꼬리를 망가뜨렸고 그것을 너무 흉하게 만들어서 Santiago가 그것의 찢어진 살점을 볼 때마다 그의 마음을 아프게 했다. Santiago felt sorry for catching the marlin and wanted to apologize to the beautiful animal.

“Don’t think, old man,” he said. “Sail on this course and take it when it comes.”
But he couldn’t stop thinking. Alone on the ocean, with the poor marlin’s blood ⓐspill into the water, all he could do was ⓑthink. He thought of the great baseball player Joe DiMaggio. He wondered if Joe DiMaggio could have killed the shark without losing the spear. Santiago thought of his own injured hands and wondered how ⓒJoe DiMaggio could play baseball so well in spite of his own injuries. He wondered if he, like Joe DiMaggio, could ignore the unbearable pain and fatigue in his body ⓓenough long to meet his goals.
“Think about something cheerful, old man,” he said. “Every minute now you are closer to home. You sail lighter for the loss of 40 pounds.”
However, Santiago knew this was false hope. Too much blood in the water. Too many sharks. Too far from land with these strong ocean currents. Still, the fisherman promised he would continue to fight. Neither fear ⓔor the loss of his spear could take away his determination. He had to come up with a new weapon, removing the rowing oars and attaching his knife to one.
“Now,” he said. “I am still an old man. But (A)______.”
The breeze got stronger and his boat sped up. He felt fresh, and his determination returned. The sharks would almost certainly take his beautiful marlin, but Santiago would never cease fighting ⓕthem. A man can be destroyed, but never defeated.

solution:
어법상 어색한 것은 총 3개이다.
ⓐ spill → spilling (전치사 with, 목적어 the poor marlin’s blood와 함께 ‘~가 …하면서’를 뜻하는 ‘with+명사(구)+분사’ 구문을 이루어야 하며, 명사구인 the poor marlin’s blood가 ‘바다로 쏟아지는’ 주체이며, spill이 ‘쏟아지다’라는 뜻의 자동사로 쓰여 뒤에 목적어 없이 전치사구 into the water가 이어지고 있으며 문맥상 ‘피가 쏟아지고 있는’ 진행의 의미를 나타내야 하므로 spill은 능동을 나타내는 현재분사 spilling으로 고친다.)
ⓓ enough long → long enough (enough가 부사로 쓰여 형용사나 부사를 수식할 때 형용사/부사의 뒤에서 수식하며, 이어지는 to부정사 to meet과 함께 ‘~하기에 충분히 …한‘ 형용사/부사+enough+to부정사’ 구문을 이루어야 하므로 enough long을 부사 long 뒤에 enough가 위치한 어순의 long enough로 고친다.)
ⓔ or → nor (앞에 Neither가 함께 쓰여 ’A도 B도 아닌’을 뜻하는 상관접속사 ’neither A nor B’ 구조를 이루어야 하므로, or를 nor로 고친다.)
오답
ⓑ 주어가 What, All, The only thing 등이 이끄는 명사절로 일반동사 do와 함께 사용될 때, 주격보어로 오는 to부정사의 to는 생략 가능하므로 all이 이끄는 주어 all he could do에 이어지는 보어 자리에 to를 생략한 원형부정사 think는 적절하다.

body:
“Don’t think, old man,” he said. “Sail on this course and take it when it comes.”
But he couldn’t stop thinking. Alone on the ocean, with the poor marlin’s blood ⓐspill into the water, all he could do was ⓑthink. He thought of the great baseball player Joe DiMaggio. He wondered if Joe DiMaggio could have killed the shark without losing the spear. Santiago thought of his own injured hands and wondered how ⓒJoe DiMaggio could play baseball so well in spite of his own injuries. He wondered if he, like Joe DiMaggio, could ignore the unbearable pain and fatigue in his body ⓓenough long to meet his goals.
“Think about something cheerful, old man,” he said. “Every minute now you are closer to home. You sail lighter for the loss of 40 pounds.”
However, Santiago knew this was false hope. Too much blood in the water. Too many sharks. Too far from land with these strong ocean currents. Still, the fisherman promised he would continue to fight. Neither fear ⓔor the loss of his spear could take away his determination. He had to come up with a new weapon, removing the rowing oars and attaching his knife to one.
“Now,” he said. “I am still an old man. But (A)______.”
The breeze got stronger and his boat sped up. He felt fresh, and his determination returned. The sharks would almost certainly take his beautiful marlin, but Santiago would never cease fighting ⓕthem. A man can be destroyed, but never defeated.

윗글의 빈칸 (A)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
choices: I’m a quitter
I am not unarmed
I’m still defenseless
my courage has vanished
I must abandon my damaged marlin
solution:
Santiago는 두려움도, 자신의 창을 잃은 것도 그의 결심을 앗아갈 수 없다며 노 하나에 칼을 부착해 새로운 무기를 마련한 상황에서, 자신은 여전히 노인이라고 말하면서도 but(하지만)으로 빈칸이 이어지고 있고, 미풍이 점차 강해지고 그의 배가 속력을 내자 그의 결의가 되살아났다는 내용이 이어지므로, 나는 여전히 노인이지만 나 자신을 방어할 수단이 있다는 흐름으로 빈칸에는 ② ‘나는 무기가 없지 않아’가 알맞다.
오답
① 나는 포기하는 사람이야
③ 나는 여전히 무방비 상태야
④ 나의 용기는 사라졌어
⑤ 나는 손상된 청새치를 포기해야 해

choices: frustrated → resigned
anxious → resolute

solution:
생각을 멈출 수 없던 Santiago는 위대한 야구선수 Joe DiMaggio를 떠올리며 자신도 그처럼 목표를 달성할 수 있을 만큼 오랫동안 몸의 견딜 수 없는 고통과 피로를 무시할 수 있을지 의문을 품었고, 집에 더 가까워지고 있으며 청새치의 살점 40파운드를 잃어 배가 더 가볍게 나아가고 있다고 기분 좋은 생각을 하지만 이것은 거짓 희망이라는 것을 알고 있었고, 물속에 흘러 들어간 너무 많은 피와 많은 상어가 나타날 위험, 그리고 강한 해류들로 인해 육지에서 너무 멀리 떨어져 있는 상황에도 불구하고, 계속 싸울 것이라고 다짐하며 노 하나에 칼을 부착해 새로운 무기를 만들고, 이후 그의 결의가 되살아나 상어들과 싸움을 결코 멈추지 않겠다고 했으므로, Santiago의 심경 변화로 ② ‘불안한 → 결심에 찬’이 알맞다.

⑤ 두려워하는 → 순종적인

Are you keen on exploring the world of literature? Is reading your hobby? Here’s an exciting type of event — literary festivals! These events are hosted in cities with rich literary histories, ⓐseparating authors and readers. Take a glance at these festivals across different regions!
Edinburgh International Book Festival
Where: Edinburgh, Scotland
The Edinburgh International Book Festival happens every year in Edinburgh, which was ⓑdesignated the first UNESCO City of Literature. The festival is one of the largest literary events globally and is typically held in August. It takes place at the University of Edinburgh’s College of Art, creating a village atmosphere. There are outdoor screens for live events, making it an ⓒengaging experience for all.
Frankfurter Buchmesse
Where: Frankfurt, Germany
The Frankfurter Buchmesse is the world’s largest book fair, drawing together publishers, authors, and book fans from across the globe. It is held for five days in October, with the initial two days usually ⓓreserved for trade visitors and professionals, while the following days are open to the general public. This fair is a ⓔmust for anybody, speaking any language, who has ambitions in the publishing world or simply loves to read.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 흐름상 어색한 것은?
solution: ⓐ separating(갈라놓는다) → connecting(연결한다)

body:
International Book Fair of Bogotá
Where: Bogotá, Colombia
The Bogotá International Book Fair (FILBo) is one of the most important annual events in Colombia. It is held at Corferias, a convention center located in the city of Bogotá. It features a wide range of authors and publishers and highlights Colombian and Latin American literature. It promotes books and literacy through various events for 15 days.
Toronto International Festival of Authors
Where: Toronto, Canada
If you’re in Toronto in September, don’t miss Canada’s oldest literary festival! It’s all about books, authors, and readers coming together. You’ll find Canadian and international writers sharing new stories and talking about writing as an art. Also, if you love mysteries, there’s the Motive Crime & Mystery Festival waiting for you in Toronto as well!
Louisiana Literature Festival
Where: Humlebaek, Denmark
The Louisiana Literature Festival is an annual literary event held in Humlebaek, which is 30 minutes north of Copenhagen, Denmark. It is held around the third weekend of August at the Louisiana Museum of Modern Art. The festival includes engaging conversations among writers as well as between writers and critics. It also features readings and diverse performances.

윗글의 목적으로 알맞은 것은?
choices: to introduce a range of renowned literary festivals held in the Americas
to criticize the growing commercialization of international literary events
to compare major international book festivals from the perspective of writers
to evaluate the relative cultural significance of literary festivals around the world
to inform readers about various international literary festivals and their distinctive features

body:
Santiago saw the shark’s jaws opening and closing in anticipation. He knew this shark no longer cared about the dangers of a boat or of a fisherman. The smell of blood took away the shark’s fear, making it brave and (A)[cautious / reckless]. Santiago didn’t have much rope left over from tying up the marlin, but he (B)[loosened / tightened] the short remaining piece of rope into a knot on his spear. ⓐ상어는 입은 벌어져 있고 이빨이 햇빛에 반짝이는 가운데 점점 더 가까워졌다.
Santiago’s mind felt strong and clear, his willpower (C)[restored / weakened]. The spear wasn’t very long, too short to hit the shark before it arrived at the marlin. Still, Santiago refused to give up. The shark’s eyes flashed and he bit the beautiful fish just above the tail. It ripped and bit and took a huge piece of meat — at least 40 pounds — out of the giant marlin.

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
(A) (B) (C)
choices: reckless tightened restored
cautious loosened weakened
reckless loosened restored
reckless tightened weakened
cautious tightened restored
solution:
(A) 이 상어가 더 이상 배나 어부로 인한 위험을 신경 쓰지 않는다는 것을 알았다는 내용에 이어지고 있으므로 피 냄새가 상어의 두려움을 없애고, 그것을 무모하고 용감하게 만들었다는 흐름이 되어야 한다. 따라서 reckless(무모한)가 알맞다.
cautious 신중한
(B) Santiago는 청새치를 묶고 남은 밧줄이 별로 없었다는 내용과 역접의 but(그러나)으로 연결되므로, 그는 남은 짧은 밧줄 조각을 창에 단단히 조여 매듭을 지었다는 흐름이 되어야 한다. 따라서 tightened(~을 단단히 조였다)가 알맞다.
loosened ~을 느슨하게 했다
(C) Santiago의 정신은 강해지고 맑아졌다고 했으므로 그의 의지력이 회복되었다는 흐름이 되어야 한다. 따라서 restored(회복된)가 알맞다.
weakened 약해진

body:
The old man could hear the marlin’s skin tearing and bones breaking as he drove the spear into the shark’s head. He pushed the weapon in right behind the eyes and above the neck, where the brain was. It turned over, and he could see the shark’s eyes rolling in its head. It hit the water with its tail and turned the ocean water white with its struggling.
Santiago tried to get his spear out, but couldn’t. He had cast the spear too deep into the shark’s body, and the rope was too short. Even though its body struggled, the shark was already dead. After a moment, it lay still on the surface before sinking slowly into the water, taking the spear with it.

다음 글의 제목으로 알맞은 것은?
choices: Santiago Defeats the Shark but Loses His Spear
Santiago’s Futile Attempt to Pierce the Shark with His Spear
Santiago’s Desperate Endeavor to Escape from the Merciless Shark
The Old Man’s Increasing Fear After Witnessing the Shark’s Strength
Santiago‘s Strategic Retreat in the Face of an Overwhelming Threat
solution:
Santiago가 상어에게 창을 깊숙이 찔러 넣어 상어를 죽이는 데 성공하지만, 창이 상어의 몸에 너무 깊이 박힌 데다 밧줄도 짧아 회수하지 못하고, 결국 상어가 창과 함께 물속으로 가라앉았다는 내용이므로, 글의 제목으로 ① ‘산티아고는 상어를 물리치지만 창을 잃는다’가 알맞다.
오답
② 자신의 창으로 상어를 꿰뚫으려는 Santiago의 헛된 시도
③ 무자비한 상어로부터 탈출하려는 Santiago의 필사적인 노력
④ 상어의 힘을 목격한 후 커지는 노인의 두려움
⑤ 압도적인 위협에 직면한 Santiago의 전략적 후퇴

body:
So much of the marlin’s blood flowed into the water from where it had (A)[bitten / been bitten]. Santiago knew more sharks would come before long. He had no spear, and his boat was still many miles from the land. The fisherman knew he would fail, understanding that he had no hope of protecting the beautiful marlin. Santiago didn’t care. He would struggle as long as he could, even if he could not succeed.
“A man can be destroyed,” he said. “But not (B)[defeating / defeated].”
Santiago turned back to his boat and looked at the great fish. The shark had ruined the marlin’s powerful tail and (C)[made / making] it so ugly it hurt Santiago’s spirit whenever he looked at its torn flesh. Santiago felt sorry for catching the marlin and wanted to apologize to the beautiful animal.

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
(A) (B) (C)
choices: been bitten defeated making
bitten defeated made
been bitten defeated made
bitten defeating making
been bitten defeating made
solution:
(A) 관계부사 where가 이끄는 절의 주어 it(= the marlin)이 타동사 bite(~을 물다)의 대상이며 뒤에 이어진 목적어가 없으므로, had에 이어져 과거완료 수동태(had+been+p.p.)를 이루는 been bitten이 알맞다.
(B) 주어인 A man은 defeat(패배시키다, 물리치다)의 대상이며 뒤에 이어진 목적어가 없으므로, 수동의 의미를 나타내는 과거분사 defeated가 알맞다. 참고로, ‘a man cannot be defeated’에서 앞의 절과 중복되는 부분이 생략된 표현이다.
(C) 과거완료(had p.p.) 시제를 이루는 과거분사 ruined와 등위접속사 and로 병렬구조를 이루고 있으므로 과거분사 made가 적절하다.

W: Hello, everyone! Today, we’re going to talk about color selection for presentation slides. The idea is ⓐsimilar to picking out clothes that best suit you. In the same way, the color of your slides should ⓑcontradict the topic of your presentation. This is because each color ⓒgives off a unique feeling. For example, if you were doing a presentation about the power of dance, what color would you choose? Some of you may choose red. I think that’s a ⓓterrific idea. That’s because red symbolizes the powerful, passionate emotions of dancers. This is how we ⓔcombine images and colors.
위 담화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 흐름상 어색한 것은?
solution:
ⓑ contradict(~와 모순된다) → match(~와 어울리다)
본문변형 ⓓ great(훌륭한, 멋진) → terrific(아주 멋진)

body:
W: Hello, everyone! Today, we’re going to talk about color selection for presentation slides. The idea is ⓐsimilar to picking out clothes that best suit you. In the same way, the color of your slides should ⓑcontradict the topic of your presentation. This is because each color ⓒgives off a unique feeling. For example, if you were doing a presentation about the power of dance, what color would you choose? Some of you may choose red. I think that’s a ⓓterrific idea. That’s because red symbolizes the powerful, passionate emotions of dancers. This is how we ⓔcombine images and colors.
위 담화의 목적으로 알맞은 것은?
choices: to recommend choosing clothes whose colors match the presentation topic
to explain the significance of selecting slide colors which fit the presentation topic
to demonstrate why red is the most commonly used color in presentation slides
to illustrate how dancers use colors to make their performances more powerful
to emphasize that we should refrain from discussing presentation topics related to colors
solution:
각각의 색마다 독특한 느낌을 주기 때문에 슬라이드의 색상을 발표 주제에 맞게 선택해야 하며, 춤의 힘에 대한 발표의 경우 댄서들의 강렬하고 열정적인 감정을 상징하는 빨간색을 선택하는 것을 그 예로 제시하고 있으므로, 담화의 목적으로 ② ‘발표 주제에 맞는 슬라이드 색상을 선택하는 것의 중요성을 설명하기 위해’가 알맞다.
오답
① 발표 주제와 색상이 어울리는 옷을 선택할 것을 권하기 위해
③ 빨간색이 발표 슬라이드에서 가장 흔히 사용되는 색인 이유를 보여주기 위해
④ 댄서들이 공연을 더욱 강렬하게 만들기 위해 색상을 어떻게 사용하는지를 보여주기 위해
⑤ 색상과 관련된 발표 주제를 논의하는 것을 삼가야 한다는 점을 강조하기 위해

body:
Colors strengthen the emotions of viewers due to their ability to evoke strong psychological reactions. An excellent example can be found in an animated film where an ordinary citizen becomes a superhero to defeat a villain. At the beginning of the film, the male character, who was once a superhero but had to return to living an ordinary life, is surrounded by dull colors and gray tones. He is working as if he were an ordinary person, hiding his true power. However, when he returns to work as a superhero, the film fills up with bold reds, yellows, and blues. These colors represent power and happiness. This shift reflects his emotional development, and viewers can grasp his mood without words. Through such a process, colors impact the emotional experience of the audience.
다음 글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문은?
choices: What ability of colors allows them to intensify the emotions of viewers?
Why did the male character in the animated film have to return to living an ordinary life?
What color tones characterize the surroundings of the male character early in the film?
When does the film begin to fill up with vivid colors?
How can viewers figure out the character’s mood without words?
solution:
영화 초반 한때 슈퍼히어로였지만 평범한 삶으로 돌아와야 했던 남성 캐릭터가 칙칙한 색상과 회색 톤으로 둘러싸여 있다는 내용만 언급되어 있고, 그가 평범한 삶으로 돌아온 이유는 제시되어 있지 않으므로, ② ‘애니메이션 영화에서 남성 캐릭터는 왜 평범한 삶으로 돌아와야 했는가?‘는 글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문이다.
오답
① 색상의 어떤 능력이 관객의 감정을 강화할 수 있게 하는가? (→강한 심리적 반응을 불러일으킬 수 있는 능력)
③ 영화 초반에 어떤 색조가 남성 캐릭터 주변의 특징을 이루는가? (→칙칙한 색상과 회색 톤.)
④ 영화는 언제 선명한 색상으로 가득 차기 시작하는가? (→남성 캐릭터가 슈퍼히어로로 되돌아가 활동할 때)
⑤ 관객들은 어떻게 말없이도 캐릭터의 기분을 파악할 수 있는가? (→ 캐릭터의 정서적 성장을 나타내는 색상의 변화를 통해)

body:
Like the saying “______,” colors get a film’s message across more strongly than words. A good example is the red coat in a movie about the true story of a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews from the Nazis during World War II. While the movie was mostly in black and white, the director chose one particular thing to add color to. It was the red coat of a single lost girl, alone in a crowd of frightened Jews. As such, it was the strong contrast of colors that enabled the director to powerfully symbolize the brutality of the Nazis. The young girl represents innocence while also representing the violence of the Nazis. So, what happened to this young girl? The movie never tells us for sure, but later in the film we see a dead girl in a red coat being loaded into a cart.
윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
choices: All that glitters is not gold
There are two sides to every story
A picture paints a thousand words
The pen is mightier than the sword
The grass is always greener on the other side
solution:
색상은 영화의 메시지를 말보다 더 강하게 전달한다는 내용이 흑백과 붉은색의 대비를 통해 나치의 잔혹성을 강력하게 나타낸 한 구체적 영화의 예시와 함께 이어지므로, 말보다 시각적 이미지가 의미 전달에 더욱 효과적이라는 내용의 속담을 언급하는 흐름이 되어야 한다. 따라서 빈칸에는 ③ ‘그림 하나가 천 마디의 말을 그려낸다’가 알맞다.
본문변형 빈칸은 원래 지문에서 ‘A picture is worth a thousand words’였음

body:
Colors strengthen the emotions of viewers due to their ability ⓐto evoke strong psychological reactions. An excellent example can be found in an animated film ⓑwhere an ordinary citizen becomes a superhero to defeat a villain. (A) At the beginning of the film, the male character, who was once a superhero but had to return to living an ordinary life, ⓒis surrounded by dull colors and gray tones. (B) He is working as if he ⓓhad been an ordinary person, hiding his true power. (C) These colors represent power and happiness. (D) This shift ⓔreflecting his emotional development, and viewers can grasp his mood without words. (E) Through such a process, colors impact the emotional experience of the audience.
윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것을 모두 고르면?
solution:
ⓓ had been → were (주절의 동사구(is working)와 같은 현재 시점에서 반대되는 사실을 가정해 ‘마치 ~인 것처럼’이라는 뜻을 나타내야 하므로, ‘as if+가정법 과거(주어+were/과거동사~)’를 사용해 had been을 were로 고친다. 참고로, ‘as if+가정법 과거완료(주어+had+been/p.p.~)’는 ‘마치 ~였던/~했던 것처럼’이라는 뜻으로 주절보다 이전의 시점에서 반대되는 상황을 가정할 때 쓰인다.)
ⓔ reflecting → reflects (콤마(,)와 등위접속사 and 뒤에 완전한 절(viewers can ~ words)이 이어지므로, 콤마(,) 앞도 완전한 절(주어+동사~)의 형태를 이루어야 한다. 따라서 주어 This shift 뒤에 명사구 his emotional development를 목적어로 취하는 능동태 동사가 흐름상 현재시제로 쓰여야 하며, 주어가 단수명사구이므로 단수동사로 수일치 시켜 reflecting을 reflects로 고친다.)
오답
ⓒ 주어 the male character와 두 개의 콤마(,)로 삽입되어 주어를 부연 설명하는 관계사절 ‘who ~ life‘ 뒤에 문장의 동사(구)가 와야 하며, 주어가 타동사 surround(~을 둘러싸다)의 대상이고, ’~에 둘러싸여 있다‘라는 뜻으로 ’be surrounded by ~‘를 사용하므로, 단수명사구인 주어에 수일치한 단수형 be동사 is를 쓴 is surrounded by는 알맞다.

body:
Film directors capture the changes in their characters’ lives through changes in color. Another film from the 1990s follows the dramatic experience of a man with scissor hands who comes down to a town to live with ordinary folks. He always wears black, and the castle where he used to live was a gray and gloomy place. However, in the town where he came to live with his lover, each house is painted (A)[similarly / differently], and the people wear colorful clothes. At first, he is welcomed by the people in town, but as he becomes misunderstood and disliked, the film’s colors gradually become (B)[brighter / darker]. Eventually, he returns to his castle, but he fills his garden with green grass and beautiful, blooming flowers. Moreover, ice powder from his ice sculpture blows in the wind like snow. With such changes, the director shows the audience that his life has become much more (C)[joyful / miserable].
Film directors choose colors to give us the best possible experience. ⓐ영화를 볼 때, 왜 특정 색상들이 한 장면에서 사용되는지 생각하라. You may not know the answer, but your understanding of the film will be deeper.
윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
choices: similarly brighter joyful
similarly brighter miserable
differently darker miserable
differently brighter miserable
differently darker joyful
solution:
(A) 영화 속의 가위손을 가진 남자가 항상 검은 옷을 입고 있고 그가 예전에 살던 성은 회색빛의 우울한 장소였다는 내용 뒤에 However(그러나)로 대조적인 분위기의 내용이 이어져야 하므로, 마을들은 집집마다 각기 다른 색으로 칠해져 있고 사람들이 다채로운 옷을 입고 있다는 흐름이 되어야 한다. 따라서 differently(다르게)가 알맞다.
similarly 비슷하게
(B) 영화감독들이 색상의 변화를 통해 캐릭터의 삶의 변화를 포착해낸다는 것을 보여주는 예시로서 영화가 제시되었으므로, 가위손을 가진 남자가 오해받고 미움을 받게 되면서 영화의 색상이 더 어두워진다는 흐름이 되어야 한다. 따라서 darker(더 어두운)가 알맞다.
brighter 더 밝은
(C) 남자가 성으로 다시 돌아온 후 자신의 정원을 초록빛 풀과 아름답고 활짝 핀 꽃들로 가득 채우며, 그의 얼음 조각상에서 나오는 얼음 가루는 눈처럼 바람에 날린다고 했으므로, 감독이 밝은색과 이미지로의 변화를 통해 남자의 삶이 훨씬 더 즐거워졌음을 보여준다는 흐름이 되어야 한다. 따라서 much more 뒤에 joyful(즐거운)이 알맞다.
miserable 비참한
본문변형 happier → more joyful

body:
Colors are an important aspect of films. They look visually (A)[attractive / attractively] and can be used to convey various emotions and messages to the audience. Film directors carefully select colors like bright yellow to bring a sense of hope, calm blue for peace, and intense red for violence. These color choices are not random; they are intentionally made to impact your experience while you watch the film, even if you don’t consciously notice them. Below are several outstanding examples of how (B)[skillful / skillfully] film directors can use color to add richness to the story and (C)[evoke / evoking] specific emotions from the audience.
다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
choices: attractive skillfully evoking
attractively skillfully evoke
attractively skillful evoking
attractive skillful evoke
attractive skillfully evoke
solution:
(A) ‘look+보어(~하게 보이다)’의 2형식 감각동사로 쓰인 look의 보어로 형용사(구)가 와야 하며, 보어 자리에 부사(구)는 쓸 수 없으므로, 부사 visually의 수식을 받아 형용사구를 이루는 형용사 attractive가 알맞다.
(B) 의문부사 how는 형용사나 부사를 수식해 의문사구를 이룰 수 있으나, 일반동사를 포함한 동사구 can use를 수식해야 하므로, 부사 skillfully가 알맞다.
(C) 목적을 나타내는 부사적 용법의 to부정사 to add와 등위 접속사 and에 의해 병렬로 연결되어 ‘불러일으키기 위해’라는 의미를 나타내야 하므로, to를 생략한 동사원형 evoke가 알맞다.

body:
The national flags of various European countries are tricolored, with the original being the French flag. The flags of Bolivia, Italy, and Ireland ⓐ[resemble / resembles] the French flag with three colors, while Germany, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, and Russia use three colors with parallel bands. The symbolism of the three colors in each country is different.
Ireland
The Irish tricolor consists of green, white, and orange. It was crafted in celebration of the French Revolution and as a wish for the success of Ireland’s own revolution. Green symbolizes the Irish Catholics, orange represents the Irish Protestants, and white signifies harmony and peace between the two communities.
France
The French tricolor flag, a product of the declaration of the “rights of man” during the French Revolution stating, “All men are born free and equal,” has served as an example for the tricolor flags of numerous countries that followed. The French flag consists of blue, white, and red, ⓑ[symbolizes / symbolizing] liberty, equality, and fellowship.
Germany
The German flag, with its colors of black, red, and gold, has evolved to symbolize unification, liberty, and democracy. These colors came from the reunification of Germany formerly without specific meanings. In modern times, black represents persistence, red represents courage and strength, and gold symbolizes generosity. This flag with three colors, introduced in the late 18th century, became prominent in the 19th century.
Italy
Italy, influenced by the French Revolution in its unification, initially adopted a flag with green, white, and red, along with a shield and cross. However, in 1946, these symbols were removed from the tricolor. The colors symbolize Italy’s landscape and human rights, with red ⓒ[represented / representing] love and the conflict from the Wars of Italian Independence and Unification, and white symbolizing faith and the snowy Alps.
윗글의 괄호 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
choices: resemble symbolizing representing
resembles symbolizing representing
resemble symbolizing represented
resembles symbolizes represented
resemble symbolizes representing
solution:
ⓐ 주어 ‘The flags of Bolivia, Italy, and Ireland‘에 대한 동사 자리이며, 주어의 핵심인 The flags가 복수명사구이므로, 복수동사로 수일치한 resemble이 알맞다.
ⓑ 동사가 있는 완전한 절(The French flag consists ~ red)에 접속사 없이 콤마(,)로만 이어지므로 분사구문을 이루는 분사 자리이며, 뒤에 목적어로 명사구(liberty, equality, and fellowship)가 있으므로 능동을 나타내는 현재분사 symbolizing이 알맞다.
ⓒ ‘~가 …한 채로, ~가 …하면서’를 뜻하는 ‘with+명사(구)+분사(구)’ 구문을 이루는 분사 자리로, 명사 red가 ’상징하는‘ 주체이고 뒤에 목적어(love ~ Unification)가 이어지므로, 능동을 나타내는 현재분사 representing이 알맞다.

윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것을 모두 고르면?
choices: The tricolor flags of many countries have been modeled after the French flag.
Peaceful relations and harmony between the Catholic and Protestant communities are represented by the white color of the Irish flag.

The colors of the German flag symbolized persistence, courage and strength, and generosity from the beginning.

solution:
독일 국기의 검은색, 빨간색, 금색은 통일, 자유, 민주주의를 상징하는 것으로 발전했으며, 이 색깔들은 이전에는 특정한 의미가 없었던 독일 재통일에서 비롯되었고, 현대에는 검은색은 끈기를, 빨간색은 용기와 힘을, 금색은 관용을 상징한다고 했으므로, ④ ‘독일 국기의 색깔들은 처음부터 끈기, 용기와 힘, 그리고 관용을 상징했다.’는 일치하지 않는 내용이다.
이탈리아는 통일 과정에서 프랑스 혁명의 영향을 받아 처음에는 방패와 십자가가 함께 있는 녹색, 흰색, 빨간색의 국기를 채택했으나 1946년에 이 상징들은 삼색 국기에서 제거되었다고 했으므로, ⑤ ‘이탈리아는 1946년에 원래의 삼색 국기에 방패와 십자가를 추가했다.’는 일치하지 않는 내용이다.
오답
① 많은 나라의 삼색 국기는 프랑스 국기를 본보기로 삼아 만들어졌다.
② 가톨릭과 개신교 공동체의 평화로운 관계와 화합은 아일랜드 국기의 흰색으로 나타내어진다.
③ 프랑스 삼색 국기는 모든 사람의 자유와 평등에 대한 권리를 상징한다.

body:
Like the saying “A picture is worth a thousand words,” colors get a film’s message across more strongly than words (A)do. A good example is the red coat in a movie about the true story of a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews from the Nazis during World War II. (B)While the movie was mostly in black and white, the director chose one particular thing to add color to. It was the red coat of a single lost girl, alone in a crowd of frightened Jews. As such, it was the strong contrast of colors (C)that enabled the director to powerfully symbolize the brutality of the Nazis. The young girl represents innocence (D)while also representing the violence of the Nazis. So, what happened to this young girl? The movie never tells us for sure, but later in the film we see a dead girl in a red coat (E)being loaded into a cart.
다음 글의 밑줄 친 (A)~(E)에 대한 설명으로 알맞지 않은 것은?
choices: (A): 동사구 ‘get a film’s message across’의 반복을 피하기 위해 쓰였으며, 생략할 수 있다.
(B): ‘~인 반면에’라는 의미로 쓰여 주절과 대조되는 의미의 부사절을 이끌고 있다.
(C): 선행사인 the strong contrast of colors를 수식하는 관계사절을 이끄는 주격 관계대명사이며, which로 바꾸어 쓸 수 있다.
(D): while she also represents 또는 while she is also representing으로 바꾸어 쓸 수 있다.
(E): see의 목적어인 a dead girl in a red coat가 ‘실리는’ 대상이며 진행 중인 상황을 나타내므로, 수동태 현재분사구 being loaded가 쓰였다.
solution:

body:
Film directors capture the changes in their characters’ lives through changes in color. Another film from the 1990s ⓐfollows the dramatic experience of a man with scissor hands who comes down to a town to live with ordinary folks. He always wears black, and the castle ⓑin which he used to live was a gray and gloomy place. However, in the town where he came to live with his lover, each house ⓒis painted differently, and the people wear colorful clothes. At first, he is welcomed by the people in town, but as he becomes misunderstood and ⓓdisliked, the film’s colors gradually become darker. Eventually, he returns to his castle, but he fills his garden with green grass and beautiful, blooming flowers. Moreover, ice powder from his ice sculpture blows in the wind like snow. With such changes, the director shows the audience ⓔwhat his life has become much happier.
Film directors choose colors ⓕto give us the best possible experience. When watching movies, consider why specific colors are used in a scene. You may not know the answer, but your understanding of the film will be deeper.
윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ 중, 어법상 어색한 것의 개수는?
choices: 1개
2개
3개
4개
5개
solution:
어법상 어색한 것은 1개이다.
ⓔ what → that (동사 shows와 간접목적어인 the audience 뒤에 이어진 직접목적어 자리에서 완전한 절(his life has become much happier)을 이끌어, ’show+간접목적어+직접목적어(that절)(~에게 …라는 것을 보여주다)‘ 형태의 4형식 구문을 이루어야 하므로, what을 명사절 접속사 that으로 고친다. 참고로, 관계대명사 또는 의문대명사 what은 불완전한 절을 이끌어 명사절을 이룬다.)
오답
ⓑ 완전한 절(he used to live)을 이끌어 선행사인 명사구 the castle을 수식하는 관계사절을 이루어야 하므로, 선행사에 어울리는 전치사를 쓴 ’전치사+관계대명사‘인 in which는 알맞다.
본문변형 where → in which

solution:
가위손을 가진 한 남자는 항상 검은 옷을 입고 있고, 마을 사람들은 다채로운 옷을 입고 있다고 했으므로, ② ‘영화에서 마을 사람들은 가위손을 가진 남자와 대조적으로 밝은 옷을 입는다.’는 일치 내용이다.
남자가 오해받고 미움을 받게 되면서 영화의 색깔은 점점 더 어두워진다고 했으므로, ③ ‘마을 사람들이 남자에게 등을 돌리면서, 더 어두운 색상이 점차 영화를 지배하기 시작한다.’는 일치 내용이다.
오답
① 영화감독들은 캐릭터들의 삶의 변화와 관계없이 일관된 색상을 유지한다. (→영화감독들은 색상의 변화를 통해 캐릭터들의 삶의 변화를 포착해낸다.)
④ 성 주변의 변화는 그 남자의 정서적 고통이 과거에 그랬던 것보다 더 악화되었음을 나타낸다. (→성의 변화들을 통해 감독은 관객들에게 그의 삶이 훨씬 더 행복해졌음을 보여준다.)
⑤ 일부 영화에서 색상을 사용하는 목적은 명확하지 않으며, 이는 영화를 이해하기 어렵게 한다. (→영화를 볼 때 특정 장면에서 왜 특정 색상이 사용되는지 생각해 본다면, 정답을 모를 수도 있지만 영화에 대한 이해는 더욱 깊어질 것이다.)

body:
Colors help audiences grasp the connections between characters, places, and important objects in films, making complex stories easier to understand. There is a film from the 1930s that shows the adventures of a girl attempting to return home after being swept away in a flash by a tornado to a land of magic. The director uses colors to effectively communicate with the audience. The girl’s life in a boring village is shown in black and white, and the world of magic is expressed in various colors in the movie. With such color differences, the audience can ______. Audiences watching this film are immersed in the world of magic as if they were the girl when watching the scenes that turn to color in a flash.
윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
choices: lose track of where the events in the story are happening
overlook the visual contrast between the two different worlds
easily identify which of the two worlds each event occurs in
interpret both worlds as having nearly the same visual atmosphere
notice and distinguish the characters’ various psychological changes
solution:
글의 초반에 색상은 영화 속 캐릭터, 장소, 중요한 물건들 간의 연관성을 이해하도록 도와 복잡한 이야기를 이해하기 더 쉽게 만든다고 했으며, 그 예시로 제시된 영화에서 지루한 마을에서의 소녀의 생활은 흑백으로, 마법의 세계는 다양한 색상으로 표현되어 있다고 했으므로, 이러한 색상의 차이 덕분에 관객은 사건들이 어느 세계에서 일어나는지를 구분할 수 있다는 흐름이 되어야 한다. 따라서 빈칸에는 ③ ‘각 사건이 두 세계 중 어디에서 일어나고 있는지 쉽게 파악하다’가 알맞다.
본문변형 빈칸은 원래 ‘distinguish which world the events take place in’이었음
오답
① 이야기의 사건들이 어디에서 일어나고 있는지를 놓치다
② 두 개의 다른 세계 사이의 시각적 대비를 간과하다
④ 두 세계가 거의 동일한 시각적 분위기를 지닌 것으로 해석하다
⑤ 등장인물들의 다양한 심리적 변화를 알아채고 구분하다

body:
M: Minji, we need to decide on the color of the T-shirts we’re going to wear for Sports Day.
W: You’re right. We have some survey results from our classmates. Did red get the most votes? I can’t remember.
M: Blue was the top choice.
W: Ah, I heard that Class 2 has already chosen blue.
M: We can’t be the same color. What if we mix another color with blue to set it apart?
W: ______ What about yellow stripes?
M: I think black stripes would look good, too.
W: We should let our classmates choose between the two.
M: Sounds good. I’ll prepare the survey. We’ll ask them to make a choice by lunchtime tomorrow.
W: Thanks. I’ll prepare the T-shirt images for the survey right away.

choices: That’s a great idea.
What a brilliant idea!
I’m in favor of that idea.
I think that would work well.
I have some doubts about that idea.

body:
Colors strengthen the emotions of viewers due to their ability to evoke strong psychological reactions. An excellent example can be found in an animated film where an ordinary citizen becomes a superhero to defeat a villain.
(A) This shift reflects his emotional development, and viewers can grasp his mood without words. Through such a process, colors impact the emotional experience of the audience.

(C) However, when he returns to work as a superhero, the film fills up with bold reds, yellows, and blues. These colors represent power and happiness.

위 주어진 글에 이어질 순서로 알맞은 것은?
solution: 색상은 강한 심리적 반응을 불러일으키는 능력으로 인해 관객의 감정을 강화시키며, 평범한 시민이 슈퍼히어로가 되는 한 애니메이션 영화에서 훌륭한 예시를 찾을 수 있다는 내용의 주어진 글 다음에, 앞서 언급된 영화를 the film으로 가리켜 ‘그 영화’의 초반에는 한때 슈퍼히어로였던 남성 캐릭터가 칙칙한 색상과 회색 톤으로 둘러싸여 있고 마치 보통 사람인 것처럼 일하고 있다고 설명하는 (B), However(그러나)를 사용해 그가 슈퍼히어로로 되돌아가 활동하는 반전의 상황을 제시하며, 영화는 강렬한 빨강, 노랑, 파랑으로 가득 차 있고 이 색상들은 힘과 행복을 상징한다고 설명하는 (C), 칙칙한 색상과 회색 톤에서 빨강, 노랑, 파랑으로의 색상의 변화를 This shift로 가리켜 ‘이러한 변화’는 그의 정서적 성장을 나타내며, 관객들은 말없이도 그의 기분을 이해할 수 있다고 설명하는 (A)로 이어지는 것이 알맞다.

Colors help audiences grasp the connections between characters, places, and important objects in films, making complex stories easier to understand. (A)There is a film from the 1930s that shows the adventures of a girl attempting to return home after being swept away in a flash by a tornado to a land of magic. (B)The director uses colors to effectively communicate with the audience. (C)The director also experimented with different techniques to improve the quality of sound in the film. (D)The girl’s life in a boring village is shown in black and white, and the world of magic is expressed in various colors in the movie. (E)With such color differences, the audience can distinguish which world the events take place in. Audiences watching this film are immersed in the world of magic ⓐ______.

윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)~(E) 중, 흐름상 관계없는 문장은?
solution: 색상은 관객들이 영화 속 캐릭터, 장소, 중요한 물건들 간의 연관성을 이해하도록 도와 복잡한 이야기를 이해하기 더 쉽게 만든다는 점을 설명하기 위해 토네이도에 휩쓸려 마법의 나라로 가게 된 한 소녀의 모험을 다룬 영화를 예로 들고 있으며, 감독이 마을에서의 지루한 생활은 흑백으로, 마법의 세계는 다양한 색상으로 표현함으로써 관객들은 사건들이 어느 세계에서 일어나는지를 구분할 수 있다고 설명하는 흐름이므로, 색상의 사용이 아닌 음향 기술과 관련된 기술적 시도를 언급하는 (C) ‘감독은 또한 영화의 음향 품질을 향상하기 위해 다양한 기법을 실험했다.’는 글의 전체 흐름과 관계없다.

body:
Film directors ⓐcapture the changes in their characters’ lives through changes in color. Another film from the 1990s follows the dramatic experience of a man with scissor hands who comes down to a town to live with ordinary folks. He always wears black, and the castle where he used to live was a gray and ⓑdreary place. However, in the town where he came to live with his lover, each house is painted differently, and the people wear colorful clothes. At first, he is ⓒrejected by the people in town, but as he becomes misunderstood and disliked, the film’s colors gradually become darker. Eventually, he returns to his castle, but he fills his garden with green grass and beautiful, blooming flowers. Moreover, ice powder from his ice sculpture blows in the wind like snow. With such changes, the director shows the audience that his life has become much ⓓhappier.
Film directors choose colors to give us the best possible experience. When watching movies, consider why specific colors are used in a scene. You may not know the answer, but your understanding of the film will be ⓔdeeper.

body:
The national flags of various European countries are tricolored, with the original ⓐbeing the French flag. The flags of Bolivia, Italy, and Ireland resemble the French flag with three colors, while Germany, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, and Russia use three colors with parallel bands. The symbolism of the three colors in each country ⓑare different.
Ireland
The Irish tricolor consists of green, white, and orange. It was crafted in celebration of the French Revolution and as a wish for the success of Ireland’s own revolution. Green symbolizes the Irish Catholics, orange represents the Irish Protestants, and white ⓒsignifying harmony and peace between the two communities.
France
The French tricolor flag, a product of the declaration of the “rights of man” during the French Revolution ⓓstating, “All men are born free and equal,” has served as an example for the tricolor flags of numerous countries that followed. The French flag consists of blue, white, and red, symbolizing liberty, equality, and fellowship.
Germany
The German flag, with its colors of black, red, and gold, has evolved to symbolize unification, liberty, and democracy. These colors came from the reunification of Germany formerly without specific meanings. In modern times, black represents persistence, red represents courage and strength, and gold symbolizes generosity. This flag with three colors, ⓔintroduced in the late 18th century, became prominent in the 19th century.
Italy
Italy, influenced by the French Revolution in its unification, initially adopted a flag with green, white, and red, along with a shield and cross. However, in 1946, these symbols ⓕwere removed from the tricolor. The colors symbolize Italy’s landscape and human rights, with red representing love and the conflict from the Wars of Italian Independence and Unification, and white symbolizing faith and the snowy Alps.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ 중, 어법상 어색한 것의 개수는?
choices: 1개
2개
3개
4개
5개
solution:
어법상 어색한 것은 총 2개이다.
ⓑ are → is (주어 ‘The symbolism of the three colors in each country’ 뒤에 형용사 different를 보어로 취하는 be동사가 일반적 사실을 나타내는 현재시제로 쓰이는 것은 알맞으나, 핵심인 The symbolism이 단수명사구이므로, 수일치를 위해 복수동사 are를 단수동사 is로 고친다.)
ⓒ signifying → signifies (완전한 절인 ‘Green symbolizes the Irish Catholics’, ‘orange represents the Irish Protestants’와 ‘A, B, and C’의 병렬 구조를 이루는 완전한 절이 연결되어야 하므로 white를 주어로 하는 동사가 와야 한다. 따라서 signifying을 단수주어인 white에 수일치한 단수동사 signifies로 고친다.)
오답
ⓐ 전치사 with와 명사구 the original 뒤에 부대상황을 나타내는 ‘with+명사(구)+분사(구)(~가 …인 채로, ~가 …하면서)’를 이루는 분사가 올 자리이며, 뒤에 보어로 명사구 the French flag가 있으므로, be의 현재분사 being은 알맞다.
ⓓ 주어 The French tricolor flag와 동사구 has served 사이에 두 개의 콤마(,)로 삽입된 동격 어구는 명사구의 형태가 되어야 하므로 흐름상 the declaration of the “rights of man”을 수식하는 분사구를 이루는 분사가 올 수 있으며, 수식받는 명사구가 ‘명시하는’ 주체이고 뒤에 타동사 state(~라는 것을 명시하다)의 목적어로 인용부호(“ ”)와 함께 쓰인 완전한 절(“All men are born free and equal”)이 있으므로, 능동을 나타내는 현재분사 stating은 알맞다.
ⓔ 주어 This flag with three colors와 동사 became 사이에 두 개의 콤마(,)로 삽입되어 주어를 부연 설명하는 분사구를 이루는 분사가 올 수 있으며, 부연 설명의 대상인 주어가 ‘도입된’ 대상이고 타동사 introduce(~을 도입하다)의 목적어가 뒤에 없으므로, 수동을 나타내는 과거분사 introduced는 알맞다.
ⓕ 부사구 in 1946가 나타내는 과거의 일이며, 주어 these symbols가 ‘제거된’ 대상이고, 뒤에 목적어 없이 ‘remove ~ from …(~을 …에서 제거하다)’의 전치사 from이 쓰였으므로, 복수명사구인 주어에 수일치한 복수동사 were를 쓴 과거시제 수동태 were removed는 알맞다.

body:
Colors strengthen the emotions of viewers due to their ability to evoke strong psychological reactions. (A)평범한 시민이 악당을 물리치기 위해 슈퍼히어로가 되는 한 애니메이션 영화에서 훌륭한 예가 발견될 수 있다. At the beginning of the film, the male character, ⓐ[who / that] was once a superhero but had to return to living an ordinary life, is surrounded by dull colors and gray tones. He is working as if he were an ordinary person, ⓑ[hid / hiding] his true power. However, when he returns to work as a superhero, the film fills up with bold reds, yellows, and blues. These colors represent power and happiness. This shift reflects his emotional development, and viewers can grasp his mood without words. Through ⓒ[a such / such a] process, colors impact the emotional experience of the audience.

윗글의 괄호 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
ⓐ ⓑ ⓒ
choices: who / hid / such a
who / hiding / a such
that / hiding / such a
who / hiding / such a
that / hid / a such
solution:
ⓐ 콤마(,) 뒤에서 주어가 없는 불완전한 절(was ~ life)을 이끌어 주어인 the male character를 부연 설명하는 관계사절을 이루고 있으며, 선행사가 사람이므로 주격 관계대명사 who가 알맞다. 참고로, 계속적 용법으로 관계대명사 that은 쓸 수 없다.
ⓑ 완전한 절(He ~ person) 다음에 접속사 없이 콤마(,)로만 이어지므로 분사구문을 이루는 분사 자리이며, 주절인 ‘he ~ person’의 주어와 동일한 분사구문의 의미상 주어 he가 ‘숨기는’ 주체이고 뒤에 목적어로 명사구(his true power)가 이어지므로 능동을 나타내는 현재분사 hiding이 알맞다.
ⓒ such는 명사(구)를 수식하며 ‘such+a(n)+(형용사+)명사(구)’의 구조를 이루므로, such 뒤에 관사 a가 쓰인 어순의 such a가 알맞다.

body:
Like the saying “A picture is worth a thousand words,” colors get a film’s message across (A)[more / less] strongly than words. A good example is the red coat in a movie about the true story of a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews from the Nazis during World War II. While the movie was mostly in black and white, the director chose one particular thing to add color to. It was the red coat of a single lost girl, alone in a crowd of (B)[delighted / terrified] Jews. As such, it was the strong contrast of colors that enabled the director to powerfully symbolize the brutality of the Nazis. The young girl represents (C)[innocence / hope] while also representing the violence of the Nazis. So, what happened to this young girl? The movie never tells us for sure, but later in the film we see a dead girl in a red coat being loaded into a cart.

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
(A) (B) (C)
choices: more / delighted / innocence
less / terrified / innocence
more / terrified / innocence
less / delighted / hope
more / terrified / hope
solution:
(A) ‘그림은 천 마디 말의 가치가 있다.’라는 속담을 인용하고 있으므로, 색상은 영화의 메시지를 말보다 더 강력하게 전달한다는 흐름이 되는 more(더)가 알맞다.
less 덜
(B) 강렬한 색상의 대비가 감독으로 하여금 유대인에 대한 나치의 잔혹성을 상징할 수 있게 했다는 내용이 이어지므로, 길을 잃은 한 유대인 소녀가 겁에 질린 유대인 군중 속에 있는 장면을 언급하는 흐름이 되어야 한다. 따라서 terrified(공포에 질린, 두려움에 떠는)가 알맞다.
본문변형 frightened(겁먹은, 무서워하는) → terrified(공포에 질린, 두려움에 떠는)
delighted 매우 기쁜
(C) 감독이 나치의 잔혹성을 강력하게 상징하기 위해 강렬한 색상의 대비를 사용했으며, 영화 후반부에 붉은 외투를 입은 죽은 소녀가 수레에 실리고 있는 장면을 볼 수 있다고 했으므로, 붉은 외투를 입은 어린 유대인 소녀는 나치의 폭력성과 동시에 무고하게 희생되는 소녀의 순수성을 상징한다는 흐름이 되어야 한다. 따라서 innocence(무죄, 결백, 순수함)가 알맞다.
hope 희망

body:
M: Wow, that tteokbokki looks delicious.
W: It really does, doesn’t it? By the way, ⓐdid you know that red actually stimulates hunger in most people?
M: Really? I didn’t realize that.
W: I guess that’s probably why most ramyeon packages are red.
M: Wow, that’s fascinating, but haven’t you seen some black ramyeon packets recently?
W: Black probably gives off a more luxurious feel. I bet the ramyeon in black packaging is more expensive.
M: That does make sense. I’m hungry. If you’re not tied up, let’s go grab some tteokbokki.
W: Sounds good. To tell you the truth, I’m hungry, too.
M: Since it’s your birthday tomorrow, it’s my treat.
W: That’s so nice of you!

위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ와 바꿔 쓸 수 없는 것은?
choices: have you heard that
were you aware that
were you convinced that
have you ever noticed that
did you happen to know that
solution:
빨간색이 사람들에게 배고픔을 자극한다는 사실에 대해 알고 있었는지 물으며 상대방이 몰랐다고 답하자 그런 이유에서 대부분의 라면 포장이 빨간색일 것이라고 부연 설명하는 흐름으로, ‘너는 ~라는 것을 알고 있었니?’라는 뜻의 ‘did you know that ~’은 상대방의 주의를 끌고 흥미로운 정보를 공유하거나 새로운 사실을 소개할 때 쓰는 표현이다. 따라서 어떤 사실에 대한 상대방의 과거 확신 여부를 묻는 ③ ’너는 ~을 확신했니?‘는 밑줄 친 ⓐ와 바꿔 쓸 수 없다.
오답
① 너는 ~라는 것을 들어 본 적 있니?
② 너는 ~라는 것을 알고 있니?
④ 너는 ~라는 것을 알고 있니?
⑤ 너는 혹시 ~라는 것을 알고 있었니?

body:
Colors are an important aspect of films. They look visually attractive and can be used to convey various emotions and messages to the audience. Film directors carefully select colors like bright yellow to bring a sense of hope, calm blue for peace, and intense red for violence. These color choices are not random; they are intentionally made to impact your experience while you watch the film, even if you don’t consciously notice them. Below are several outstanding examples of how skillfully film directors can use color to add richness to the story and evoke specific emotions from the audience.

다음 글의 바로 뒤에 이어질 내용으로 알맞은 것은?
choices: specific examples of how particular colors weaken a film’s story
strategies film directors adopt when using intense red for commercial success
processes by which directors and actors decide how to express various emotions
renowned film directors who have won awards for their outstanding use of colors
ways in which film directors deliberately choose colors to communicate emotions and meanings to viewers
solution:
색상은 영화의 중요한 요소로서 관객에게 다양한 감정과 메시지를 전달하는 데 사용될 수 있으며, 이러한 색상 선택은 무작위가 아니라 의도적으로 이루어진다는 내용 뒤에, 영화감독들이 색을 얼마나 능숙하게 사용하여 이야기에 풍성함을 더하고 관객에게 특정한 감정을 불러일으킬 수 있는지에 대한 몇 가지 뛰어난 사례들이 있다는 점을 예고하고 있으므로, 주어진 글 뒤에 이어질 내용으로 ⑤ ‘영화감독들이 관객에게 감정과 의미를 전달하기 위해 의도적으로 색을 선택하는 방식들’이 알맞다.
오답
① 특정 색들이 영화의 이야기를 약화시키는 방식에 대한 구체적인 사례들
② 영화감독들이 상업적 성공을 위해 강렬한 빨간색을 사용할 때 채택하는 전략들
③ 감독과 배우가 다양한 감정을 표현하는 방법을 결정하는 과정들
④ 탁월한 색의 사용으로 상을 받은 유명한 영화 감독들

body:
Colors (A)[strengthen / weaken] the emotions of viewers due to their ability to evoke strong psychological reactions. An excellent example can be found in an animated film where an ordinary citizen becomes a superhero to defeat a villain. At the beginning of the film, the male character, who was once a superhero but had to return to living an ordinary life, is surrounded by (B)[dull / vivid] colors and gray tones. ⓐ그는 자신의 진정한 힘을 숨기면서, 마치 보통 사람인 것처럼 일하고 있다. However, when he returns to work as a superhero, the film fills up with bold reds, yellows, and blues. These colors represent power and happiness. This shift (C)[reflects / inhibits] his emotional development, and viewers can grasp his mood without words. Through such a process, colors impact the emotional experience of the audience.

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
(A) (B) (C)
choices: strengthen / dull / reflects
strengthen / vivid / reflects
weaken / vivid / inhibits
strengthen / dull / inhibits
weaken / dull / reflects
solution:
(A) 강한 심리적 반응을 불러일으킬 수 있는 능력이 이유로 언급되므로, 색상은 관객의 감정을 강화시킨다는 흐름이 되는 strengthen(~을 강화시킨다)가 알맞다.
weaken ~을 약화시킨다
(B) However(하지만) 뒤에 슈퍼히어로로 되돌아가 활동할 때 영화는 강렬한 빨강, 노랑, 파랑으로 가득 찬다는 내용이 대조적으로 이어지므로, 평범한 삶은 단조롭거나 칙칙한 색깔들과 회색 톤으로 둘러싸여 있다는 흐름이 되어야 한다. 따라서 dull(흐릿한, 탁한)이 알맞다.
vivid 선명한, 강렬한
(C) 관객들은 말없이도 영화 속 캐릭터의 기분을 이해할 수 있다는 내용이 이어지므로, This shift(이러한 변화)가 가리키는 영화 속 색의 변화가 그의 정서적 성장을 나타낸다는 흐름이 되는 reflects(~을 반영한다)가 알맞다.
inhibits ~을 억제[방해]하다

body:
Like the saying “A picture is worth a thousand words,” ⓐcolors get a film’s message across more strongly than words. (A) A good example is the red coat in a movie about the true story of a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews from the Nazis during World War II. (B) While the movie was mostly in black and white, the director chose one particular thing to add color to. (C) As such, it was the strong contrast of colors that enabled the director to powerfully symbolize the brutality of the Nazis. (D) The young girl represents innocence while also representing the violence of the Nazis. (E) So, what happened to this young girl? The movie never tells us for sure, but later in the film we see a dead girl in a red coat being loaded into a cart.

윗글의 (A)~(E) 중, 주어진 문장이 들어갈 알맞은 곳은?
It was the red coat of a single lost girl, alone in a crowd of frightened Jews.
solution: 주어진 문장은 ‘그것은 겁에 질린 유대인 군중들 속에서 홀로 길을 잃은 한 소녀의 붉은 외투였다.’라는 뜻으로, It(그것)이 가리키는 것과 관련해 감독이 대부분 흑백으로 된 영화에 색을 더할 한 가지를 선택했다고 언급하는 내용 뒤이자, As such(그렇기 때문에)를 사용해 앞에 언급된 내용을 근거로 감독이 나치의 잔혹성을 강력하게 상징할 수 있게 해 준 것이 바로 강렬한 색상의 대비였다고 설명하는 문장 앞인 (C)에 들어가는 것이 알맞다.

body:
Like the saying “A picture is worth a thousand words,” ⓐcolors get a film’s message across more strongly than words. (A) A good example is the red coat in a movie about the true story of a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews from the Nazis during World War II. (B) While the movie was mostly in black and white, the director chose one particular thing to add color to. (C) As such, it was the strong contrast of colors that enabled the director to powerfully symbolize the brutality of the Nazis. (D) The young girl represents innocence while also representing the violence of the Nazis. (E) So, what happened to this young girl? The movie never tells us for sure, but later in the film we see a dead girl in a red coat being loaded into a cart.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ‘colors get a film’s message across more strongly than words’가 의미하는 바로 알맞은 것은?
choices: Colors can diminish the impact of the message a film director intends to convey.
A film’s message becomes far clearer when colors and words convey the same information.
Colors function as aesthetic devices that enhance a film’s visual appeal rather than communicate meaning.
The deliberate use of color can communicate meaning with greater impact than verbal expression alone.
The function of colors in films is to make cinematic images visually engaging and emotionally pleasing.
solution:
예시로 든 영화에서 감독은 흑백과 대비되는 소녀의 붉은 외투를 부각하여 소녀의 순수함과 동시에 나치의 폭력성을 상징한다고 설명하고 있으므로, 밑줄 친 ⓐ ‘색상은 영화의 메시지를 말보다 더 강하게 전달한다’는 색의 사용을 통해 말로 설명할 필요 없이 영화가 전달하려는 메시지를 더 효과적으로 관객에게 각인시킬 수 있다는 의미라고 볼 수 있다. 따라서 밑줄 친 ⓐ가 의미하는 바로 ④ ‘의도적인 색상의 사용은 언어적 표현만이 전달하는 것보다 더 큰 영향력을 가지고 의미를 전달할 수 있다.’가 알맞다.
오답
① 색상은 영화감독이 전달하고자 하는 메시지의 영향력을 약화시킬 수 있다.
② 영화의 메시지는 색상과 말이 동일한 정보를 전달할 때 훨씬 더 분명해진다.
③ 색상은 의미를 전달하기보다는 영화의 시각적인 매력을 높이는 미적 장치로 기능한다.
⑤ 영화에서 색상의 기능은 영화적 이미지를 시각적으로 매력 있고 정서적으로 기분 좋게 만드는 것이다.

body:
Film directors capture the changes in their characters’ lives through changes in color. Another film from the 1990s follows the dramatic experience of a man with scissor hands ⓐwhich comes down to a town to live with ordinary folks. He always wears black, and the castle where he used ⓑto live was a gray and gloomy place. However, in the town ⓒwhere he came to live with his lover, each house is painted differently, and the people wear colorful clothes. At first, he is welcomed by the people in town, but as he becomes ⓓmisunderstood and disliked, the film’s colors gradually become darker. Eventually, he returns to his castle, but he fills his garden with green grass and beautiful, blooming flowers. Moreover, ice powder from his ice sculpture ⓔblowing in the wind like snow. With such changes, the director shows the audience that (A)______.
Film directors choose colors to give us the best possible experience. When ⓕwatching movies, consider why specific colors are used in a scene. You may not know the answer, but your understanding of the film will be deeper.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ 중, 어법상 어색한 것의 개수는?
choices: 1개
2개
3개
4개
5개
solution:
어법상 어색한 것은 총 2개이다.
ⓐ which → who 또는 that (주어가 없는 불완전한 절(comes down ~ folks)을 이끌고 있으므로 주격 관계대명사가 올 자리이며, 관계사절이 수식하는 선행사가 scissor hands가 아니라 a man with scissor hands이므로, 사물 선행사와 쓰이는 which를 사람 선행사와 쓰이는 주격 관계대명사 who 또는 that으로 고친다.)
*원래 지문에는 who가 쓰였음
ⓔ blowing → blows (뒤에 다른 동사가 없으므로 주어 ice powder from his ice sculpture에 대한 동사가 올 자리이며, 글의 전체 시제를 고려해 현재시제를 써야 하고, 주어의 핵심이 단수명사구 ice powder이므로 blowing을 단수동사로 수일치한 blows로 고친다.)
오답
ⓑ ‘(과거에) ~했었다(지금은 아니다)’를 뜻하는 ‘used to+동사원형’을 이루어야 하므로, used 뒤에 쓰인 to live는 알맞다.
ⓕ 의미를 명확히 하기 위해 접속사 when을 남겨둔 ‘접속사+분사(구)’ 형태의 분사구문을 이루는 분사 자리이며, 명령문인 주절(consider ~ a scene)의 생략된 주어 you와 동일한 분사구문의 의미상 주어가 ‘보는’ 주체이고 뒤에 목적어로 명사 movies가 이어지므로, 능동을 나타내는 현재분사 watching은 알맞다.

윗글의 빈칸 (A)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
choices: his life has deteriorated considerably
he still remains trapped in his gloomy past
he now leads a more joyful life than before

solution:
영화감독들은 색상의 변화를 통해 캐릭터들의 삶의 변화를 포착해낸다고 했고, 그 예로 가위 손을 가진 한 남자의 극적인 경험을 보여주는 영화에서 그가 예전에 살았던 성은 회색빛의 우울한 장소였으나, 성으로 다시 돌아온 후 정원을 초록빛 풀과 아름답고 활짝 핀 꽃들로 가득 채우며, 얼음 조각상에서 나오는 얼음 가루는 눈처럼 바람에 날린다고 했으므로, 이런 색채의 변화를 통해 어둡고 우울했던 그의 삶이 더 밝고 행복해졌음을 보여준다는 흐름이 되어야 한다. 따라서 빈칸에는 ③ ‘그는 이제 이전보다 더 즐거운 삶을 산다’가 알맞다.
본문변형 빈칸은 원래 ‘his life has become much happier’였음
오답
① 그의 삶은 상당히 악화되었다
deteriorate 악화되다, 더 나빠지다
② 그는 여전히 자신의 우울한 과거에 갇혀 있다
④ 그는 마을을 떠난 후 평온을 찾는 데 실패했다
⑤ 그의 감정과 함께 주변 환경도 더 황량해졌다
bleak 황량한; 암울한, 어두운

body:
Colors help audiences grasp the connections between characters, places, and important objects in films, ⓐmaking complex stories easier to understand. There is a film from the 1930s ⓑwhen shows the adventures of a girl attempting to return home after being swept away in a flash by a tornado to a land of magic. The director uses colors to effectively ⓒcommunicating with the audience. The girl’s life in a boring village is shown in black and white, and the world of magic ⓓis expressed in various colors in the movie. With such color differences, the audience can distinguish which world the events take place in. Audiences watching this film ⓔare immersed in the world of magic as if they were the girl when watching the scenes that turn to color in a flash.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것을 모두 고르면?
solution:
ⓑ when → which 또는 that (주어가 없는 불완전한 절(shows ~ magic)을 이끌어 선행사인 a film from the 1930s를 수식하는 관계사절을 이루어야 하므로, when을 주격 관계대명사 which 또는 that으로 고친다.)
*원래 지문에는 that이 쓰였음
ⓒ communicating → communicate (완전한 절(The director uses colors) 뒤에 ‘효과적으로 소통하기 위해’라는 의미의 목적을 나타내는 부사적 용법의 to부정사구가 연결되어야 하므로, ‘to+부사+동사원형‘의 분리부정사 형태를 이루도록 communicating을 동사원형 communicate로 고친다.)
오답
ⓔ ’~에 몰두하다‘라는 뜻으로 ’be immersed in ~‘을 사용하므로 be동사가 올 자리이며, 주어 Audiences watching this film의 핵심단어가 복수명사 Audiences이므로, 복수동사로 수일치한 are는 알맞다.

Colors help audiences grasp the connections between characters, places, and important objects in films, ⓐmaking complex stories easier to understand. 윗글의 주제로 알맞은 것은?
choices: the advantages of presenting both ordinary and magical worlds in black and white
the development of color technology that changed films during the early twentieth century
the limited value of visual devices in helping audiences follow complex film narratives
the employment of color to enhance viewers’ understanding and involvement in film stories
the growing importance of using similar colors in guiding audiences through different settings in films
solution:
색상은 관객들이 영화 속 캐릭터, 장소, 중요한 물건들 간의 연관성을 이해하도록 도와 복잡한 이야기를 이해하기 더 쉽게 만들며, 그 예로 한 소녀가 순식간에 토네이도에 휩쓸려 마법의 나라로 가게 된 후 집으로 돌아가려는 모험을 보여주는 영화에서 지루한 마을에서의 소녀의 생활은 흑백으로, 마법의 세계는 다양한 색상으로 표현되어 이러한 색상의 차이를 통해 관객들은 사건들이 어느 세계에서 일어나는지를 구분할 수 있으며, 장면이 순식간에 컬러로 바뀔 때에는 자신들이 그 소녀가 된 것처럼 마법의 세계에 몰입하게 된다고 설명하고 있으므로, 글의 주제로 ④ ‘영화의 이야기에서 관객들의 이해와 몰입을 높이기 위한 색상의 활용’이 알맞다.
오답
① 평범한 세계와 마법의 세계를 모두 흑백으로 표현하는 것의 장점

The national flags of various European countries are tricolored, with the original being the French flag. The flags of Bolivia, Italy, and Ireland ⓐresemble the French flag with three colors, while Germany, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, and Russia use three colors with parallel bands. ㉠______
Ireland
The Irish tricolor (A)[comprises / is comprised] of green, white, and orange. It was crafted in celebration of the French Revolution and as a wish for the success of Ireland’s own revolution. Green symbolizes the Irish Catholics, orange represents the Irish Protestants, and white signifies ⓑconcord and peace between the two communities.
France
The French tricolor flag, a product of the declaration of the “rights of man” during the French Revolution stating, “All men are born free and equal,” has served as an example for the tricolor flags of numerous countries (B)[that / what] followed. The French flag consists of blue, white, and red, symbolizing ⓒoppression, equality, and fellowship.
Germany
The German flag, with its colors of black, red, and gold, has evolved to symbolize unification, liberty, and democracy. These colors came from the reunification of Germany formerly without specific meanings. In modern times, black represents persistence, red represents courage and strength, and gold symbolizes generosity. This flag with three colors, introduced in the late 18th century, became ⓓprominent in the 19th century.
Italy
Italy, (C)[influencing / influenced] by the French Revolution in its unification, initially adopted a flag with green, white, and red, along with a shield and cross. However, in 1946, these symbols were removed from the tricolor. The colors symbolize Italy’s ⓔlandscape and human rights, with red representing love and the conflict from the Wars of Italian Independence and Unification, and white symbolizing faith and the snowy Alps.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 흐름상 어색한 것은?
solution:
ⓒ oppression(억압, 압박) → liberty(자유)
본문변형 ⓑ harmony(화합, 조화) → concord(화합, 일치)
