윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
(A) (B) (C)
choices: is comprised / that / influencing
comprises / that / influenced
is comprised / what / influenced
comprises / what / influencing
is comprised / that / influenced
solution:
(A) 뒤에 목적어 없이 전치사 of가 바로 이어져 있으며, ‘~로 이루어지다, ~로 구성되다’라는 뜻으로 ‘be comprised of ~’, ‘be made up of ~’, ‘consist of ~’ 등을 사용하므로, 수동태 is comprised가 알맞다. 참고로, comprise가 타동사로 쓰이면 ‘~을 구성하다, ~을 차지하다’를 뜻하며 뒤에 목적어가 와야 한다.
본문변형 consists of → is comprised of
(B) 앞에 선행사로 명사구 numerous countries가 있고, 뒤에는 주어 없이 동사 followed가 이어져 있으므로, 주격 관계대명사 that이 알맞다. 참고로, 관계대명사 what은 선행사를 포함한다.
(C) 주어 Italy에 대한 동사로 부사 initially의 수식을 받는 adopted가 있으므로, 주어와 동사구 사이에 두 개의 콤마(,)로 삽입되어 주어인 명사 Italy를 부연 설명하는 분사구를 이루는 분사 자리이다. 부연 설명의 대상인 Italy가 ‘영향을 받는’ 대상이고 뒤에 목적어 없이 ’by+명사구‘가 바로 이어져 있으므로, 수동을 나타내는 과거분사 influenced가 알맞다.

body:
Film directors capture the changes in their characters’ lives through changes in color. Another film from the 1990s follows the dramatic experience of a man with scissor hands who comes down to a town to live with ordinary folks.
(A) At first, he is welcomed by the people in town, but as he becomes misunderstood and disliked, the film’s colors gradually become darker. Eventually, he returns to his castle, but he fills his garden with green grass and beautiful, blooming flowers.
(B) Moreover, ice powder from his ice sculpture blows in the wind like snow. With such changes, the director shows the audience that his life has become much happier.
(C) He always wears black, and the castle where he used to live was a gray and gloomy place. However, in the town where he came to live with his lover, each house is painted differently, and the people wear colorful clothes.

위 주어진 글에 이어질 순서로 알맞은 것은?
solution: 영화감독들은 색상의 변화를 통해 캐릭터들의 삶의 변화를 포착해낸다는 설명과 함께 가위손을 가진 한 남자가 평범한 사람들과 함께 살기 위해 마을로 내려오는 1990년대의 영화를 사례로 언급하는 주어진 글 다음에, 가위손을 가진 남자를 He로 가리켜, 그는 항상 검은 옷을 입고 있고 예전에 살던 성은 회색빛의 우울한 장소였으나, 그가 살기 위해 온 마을은 집마다 다른 색으로 색칠되어 있고 사람들이 다채로운 옷을 입고 있다는 대조적 분위기를 설명한 (C), At first(처음에)를 사용해 그가 처음 마을에 왔을 때는 환영받았음을 언급한 뒤, 이후 오해와 미움을 받으면서 영화의 색깔이 점점 더 어두워지고 결국 성으로 다시 돌아와 자신의 정원을 초록빛 풀과 아름답고 활짝 핀 꽃들로 채운다는 내용의 (A), Moreover(또한)를 사용해 얼음 조각상에서 나오는 얼음 가루는 눈처럼 바람에 날린다는 변화된 성의 모습을 추가 설명하며, 이러한 변화를 통해 감독이 관객들에게 그의 삶이 더 행복해졌음을 보여준다고 마무리하는 (B)로 이어지는 것이 알맞다.

body:
Colors are an important aspect of films. They look visually attractive and can be used to ⓐconveying various emotions and messages to the audience. Film directors carefully select colors like bright yellow to bring a sense of hope, calm blue for peace, and intense red for violence. These color choices are not random; they are intentionally made ⓑto impact your experience while you watch the film, even if you don’t consciously notice them. Below ⓒis several outstanding examples of how skillfully film directors can use color to add richness to the story and evoke specific emotions from the audience.
Like the saying “A picture is worth a thousand words,” colors get a film’s message across more strongly than words ⓓare. A good example is the red coat in a movie about the true story of a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews from the Nazis during World War II. While the movie was mostly in black and white, the director chose one particular thing to add color to. It was the red coat of a single lost girl, alone in a crowd of frightened Jews. As such, it was the strong contrast of colors ⓔthat enabled the director to powerfully symbolize the brutality of the Nazis. The young girl represents innocence while also representing the violence of the Nazis. So, what happened to this young girl? The movie never tells us for sure, but later in the film we see a dead girl in a red coat ⓕbeing loaded into a cart.

윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것을 모두 고르면?
choices: The emotional meanings of colors are accidental results that film directors do not plan.
Directors can use colors to enrich their stories and arouse particular feelings in the audience.
The film about a German businessman was largely presented in black and white, with the red coat standing out.
Through the striking color contrast, the director softened the portrayal of the Nazis’ brutality.
In the latter part of the film, what the Nazis did to the girl in the red coat becomes clear.
solution:
영화감독들이 색을 얼마나 능숙하게 사용하여 이야기에 풍성함을 더하고 관객에게 특정한 감정을 불러일으킬 수 있는지에 대한 뛰어난 예들이 있다고 했으므로, ② ‘감독들은 색상을 사용하여 자신들의 이야기를 더욱 풍부하게 만들고 관객에게 특정한 감정을 불러일으킬 수 있다.’는 일치 내용이다.
한 독일 사업가의 실제 이야기를 다룬 한 영화의 대부분은 흑백으로 되어 있었지만, 감독은 색을 더할 특정한 한 가지로 한 소녀의 붉은 외투를 선택했다고 했으므로, ③ ‘한 독일 사업가에 관한 영화는 붉은 외투가 두드러진 채로 대체로 흑백으로 표현되었다.’는 일치 내용이다.
*두 번째 단락 위에 소제목 ‘Colors Convey a Film’s Message with Intensity‘ 생략되었음
오답
① 색상의 정서적 의미는 영화감독들이 계획하지 않은 우연한 결과이다. (→영화감독들의 색상 선택은 무작위가 아니라 의도적으로 이루어진다.)
④ 두드러진 색상 대비를 통해 감독은 나치의 잔혹성에 대한 묘사를 완화했다. (→ 감독이 나치의 잔혹성을 강력하게 상징할 수 있게 해준 것은 바로 강렬한 색상의 대비였다.)
⑤ 영화 후반부에서 나치가 붉은 외투를 입은 소녀에게 한 일이 명확해진다. (→영화는 어린 소녀에게 무슨 일이 있었는지 확실히 알려주지 않고, 붉은 외투를 입은 죽은 소녀가 수레에 실리고 있는 장면만을 보여준다.)

body:
As a loyal companion, the dog accompanies us everywhere. Sometimes we have a responsibility to help others understand our pets in public spaces. How can we do that?
(A) On the other hand, if your dog doesn’t like other dogs, you can buy an orange collar to warn other pet owners. Lastly, if your dog has vision or hearing problems, use a white collar to let everyone know.
(B) Writing phrases like “friendly” or “no dogs” can make this communication even more effective. Even though our dogs can’t speak, we can still help them express themselves.
(C) Well, did you know that choosing the right color for your dog collar can help this? If your dog has a friendly personality, it’s best to use a green collar.
위 주어진 글에 이어질 순서로 알맞은 것은?
solution: 공공장소에서 다른 사람들이 우리의 반려동물을 이해할 수 있도록 도와야 한다는 주제를 제시하며 그 방법이 무엇일지를 묻는 주어진 글에 이어, 올바른 색상의 반려견 목줄을 선택하는 것이 도움이 된다는 새로운 정보를 소개하면서 그 예로 친근한 성격의 반려견에게는 초록색 목줄을 사용하는 것이 좋다고 설명하는 (C), On the other hand(반면에)를 사용해, 친근한 성격의 반려견과 대조적으로 다른 개를 좋아하지 않는 반려견에게는 경고를 의미하는 주황색 목줄을 사용할 수 있으며, 시각이나 청각 문제가 있는 반려견에게는 흰색 목줄을 사용할 수 있다고 조언하는 (A), 색의 사용에 이은 또 다른 방법으로서 문구를 적어 소통을 더욱 효과적으로 만들 수 있다고 추가 설명한 뒤, 우리는 여전히 반려견들이 자신을 표현할 수 있도록 도울 수 있다고 실천을 강조하며 마무리하는 내용의 (B)로 이어지는 것이 자연스럽다.

An excellent example can be found in an animated film where an ordinary citizen becomes a superhero to defeat a villain. viewers can understand his feelings even without verbal explanation
viewers grasp the director’s intention through the character’s monologue

the director can freely change his mood by adjusting the soundtrack of each scene

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ 중, 어법상 어색한 것을 모두 골라 짝지은 것은?
solution:
ⓐ come → comes
(선행사 a man with scissor hands를 수식하는 관계사절에서 주격 관계대명사 who 뒤에 동사가 이어진 것은 알맞으나, 주격 관계대명사가 이끄는 절의 동사는 선행사에 수를 일치시켜야 하며, 선행사의 핵심이 hands가 아니라 단수명사구 a man이므로, 복수동사 come을 단수동사 comes로 고친다.)

Ireland

solution:
ⓐ 아일랜드 국기의 세 가지 색은 가톨릭 신자들과 아일랜드의 개신교도들, 그리고 두 공동체 간의 화합과 평화를 의미하며, 프랑스 국기의 세 가지 색은 자유, 평등, 동지애를 상징하는 등 글에 소개된 각 나라 국기의 세 가지 색은 각기 다른 상징적 의미를 나타내므로, 각 나라에서 세 가지 색의 상징성이 서로 다르다는 흐름이 되는 different(다른)가 알맞다.
ⓑ 프랑스 삼색 국기는 프랑스 혁명 중에 발표된 ‘모든 인간은 자유롭고 평등하게 태어난다’라는 ‘인간의 권리’ 선언의 산물이라고 했으므로, 프랑스 국기는 파란색, 흰색, 빨간색으로 이루어져 있으며, 자유, 평등, 동지애를 상징한다는 흐름이 되는 equity(공평, 공정)가 알맞다.
ⓒ However(그러나) 뒤에 1946년에 방패와 십자가 상징들이 없어졌다는 설명이 이어지므로, 처음에는 방패와 십자가가 함께 있는 녹색, 흰색, 빨간색의 국기를 채택했다는 대조적 흐름이 되는 introduced(~을 도입했다)가 알맞다.

Like the saying “A picture is worth a thousand words,” colors get a film’s message across more strongly than words. A good example is the red coat in a movie about the true story of a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews from the Nazis during World War II. While the movie was mostly in black and white, the director chose one particular thing (A)[added / to add] color to. It was the red coat of a single lost girl, (B)[who / which] was alone in a crowd of frightened Jews. As such, ⓐ감독이 나치의 잔혹성을 강력하게 상징할 수 있게 해준 것은 바로 색상의 강렬한 대비였다. The young girl represents innocence while also representing the violence of the Nazis. So, what happened to this young girl? The movie never tells us for sure, but later in the film we see a dead girl in a red coat (C)[loading / being loaded] into a cart.
윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
(A) (B) (C)
choices: added who being loaded
added which being loaded
added which loading
to add who loading
to add who being loaded
solution:
(A) 동사(chose)가 있는 완전한 절(the director chose ~ thing)에 접속사 없이 다른 동사(구)가 이어질 수 없으므로 준동사 자리이며, 뒤에 목적어로 명사 color가 있으므로, 흐름상 명사구 one particular thing을 ‘더할 (특정한 한 가지)’이라는 뜻으로 수식하는 형용사적 용법의 to부정사구를 이루는 능동형 to부정사 to add가 알맞다.
(B) 콤마(,) 뒤에서 주어가 없는 불완전한 절(was ~ Jews)을 이끌어 선행사인 명사 a single lost girl을 부연 설명하는 관계사절을 이루어야 하므로, 사람 선행사와 쓰이는 계속적 용법의 주격 관계대명사 who가 알맞다.
(C) ‘see+목적어+목적격보어(~가 …하는 것을 보다)’의 5형식 구문을 이루는 목적격보어로 분사구를 이루는 자리이며, 목적어 a dead girl in a red coat가 ‘실리고 있는’ 대상이고 흐름상 진행 중인 장면을 묘사하므로, 수동과 진행을 나타내는 ’being+과거분사(p.p.)‘ 형태의 being loaded가 알맞다.

Baseball is a game of statistics. It’s essential to know how many hits a batter can get and how many bases they can reach. Traditionally, batting average, which measures how often a player gets a hit, ⓐhas been considering the most important criterion. However, in baseball, there is another way to reach first base besides a hit, and that’s a walk. Nevertheless, walks aren’t included in batting average, so players who don’t get many hits but ⓑare good at getting walks could be rated too low. If players get on base in any way, they create scoring opportunities. Therefore, recent analyses have shown that on-base percentage is much more important for winning than batting averages.
A general manager of a professional baseball team in the United States, ⓒhis team could not afford to pay the biggest star players, created his own criteria for selecting players. His system valued how many bases a player averages per at-bat. It differed from the traditional batting average by taking into account not only the number of hits but also the types of hits (singles, doubles, triples, and home runs). It gave 1 point for singles, 2 points for doubles, 3 points for triples, and 4 points for home runs. Moreover, the system considered a player’s ability to draw walks as it contributes to getting on base and overall team success.

In movies, hackers are often shown sitting in front of a computer, trying to figure out other people’s passwords. Is your password safe? That depends on how ⓐsecure it was created.
According to one survey, 26% of adults ⓑuse passwords that are easy to memorize, such as birthdays or names, and surprisingly, the most common passwords used were “123456,” “password,” “12345,” “12345678,” and “qwerty.”
The passwords used for mobile phones and banks are often four digits, and these are not very secure. Each digit ⓒcan be selected from 10 numbers from 0 to 9, so there are 10⁴ possible codes. A computer can try all 10,000 combinations in the blink of an eye. Let’s assume that, for security purposes, you create a password with six or more letters. Choosing a word with six or more letters as a password may be more secure. Six letters from the 26-letter alphabet ⓓmakes a possible 26⁶ combinations, or more than 300 million total possibilities. It’s much better than a four-digit combination, though it’s still possible ⓔfor a computer to check them all in only a few seconds.
Passwords become difficult to hack when they are long and combine various characters. There can be 90²º combinations for a 20-digit password using around 90 letters, numbers, and special characters on a standard computer keyboard. However, there is a problem here as well. How will the user memorize this long password? Passwords should not be too easy but also not too complicated to memorize.
(A)______ will make it easy to memorize, even if the phrase is long. For example, if you use a passphrase like “mathfirstenglishlater,” ⓕwhat means that you will study math first and English later, it will be easy to memorize but difficult to hack. (A)단 하루 동안 썰매 조종사 역할을 하는 산타클로스가 단 한 집도 빠짐없이 어린이들에게 선물을 배달해야 하는 것은 분명하다. According to the United Nations’ 2022 World Population Prospects report, our world is home to approximately eight billion people, and among them, there are roughly two billion children under 14 years old. If we assume an average of two children per household, Santa would need to visit one billion households worldwide.
If we assume a simple distance of five meters between each house, Santa would have to cover a total distance of five billion meters, which amounts to five million kilometers. To accomplish this in one Christmas day, Santa’s noble mission remains a challenge, requiring a swift motion at a speed exceeding 200,000 kilometers per hour or approximately 58 kilometers per second. This is about 200 times faster than commercial airplanes typically fly.
Of course, it’s important to remember that this scenario is purely imaginary and impossible in the real world. But from a mathematical perspective, it’s truly fascinating to visualize the extraordinary task that Santa Claus and Rudolph would have to undertake to make Christmas magical for children around the world. It’s a sophisticated reminder that the spirit of the holiday season exceeds the boundaries of time and space, bringing joy to countless hearts.

body:
Baseball is a game of statistics. It’s essential to know how many hits a batter can get and how many bases they can reach. Traditionally, batting average, which measures how often a player gets a hit, has (A)[considered / been considered] the most important criterion. However, in baseball, there is another way to reach first base besides a hit, and that’s a walk. Nevertheless, walks aren’t included in batting average, so players who don’t get many hits but are good at getting walks could be rated too low. If players get on base in any way, they create scoring opportunities. Therefore, recent analyses have shown that on-base percentage is much more important for winning than batting averages.
A general manager of a professional baseball team in the United States, whose team could not afford (B)[to pay / paying] the biggest star players, created his own criteria for selecting players. His system valued how many bases a player averages per at-bat. It differed from the traditional batting average by taking into account not only the number of hits but also the types of hits (singles, doubles, triples, and home runs). It gave 1 point for singles, 2 points for doubles, 3 points for triples, and 4 points for home runs. Moreover, the system (C)[considered / was considered] a player’s ability to draw walks as it contributes to getting on base and overall team success.
Using such standards, the team recruited valuable players other teams declined to pay. These players had low batting averages but excelled at drawing walks and had high on-base percentages. Despite having the third-lowest total player salary in the entire Major Leagues, the team reached the playoffs two years in a row, all thanks to this analytical approach.

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
choices: been considered / to pay / considered
been considered / paying / considered
considered / to pay / was considered
been considered / to pay / was considered
considered / paying / was considered
solution:
(A) 주어가 ‘여겨진’ 대상이고, 뒤의 명사구 the most important criterion은 consider의 목적어가 아니라 수동 표현인 ‘consider+목적어+(to be+)보어(~을 …라고 여기다)’의 보어에 해당하므로, ‘be considered+(to be+)보어(…라고 여겨지다)’를 사용한 현재완료 수동태(have[has]+been+p.p.)를 이루는 been considered가 알맞다.
(B) ’~할 여유가 있다/없다‘라는 뜻으로 ’can/cannot afford+to부정사‘를 쓰므로 could not afford 뒤에 to부정사인 to pay가 알맞다.
(C) 주어 the system이 ’고려한‘ 주체로, 뒤에 고려의 대상인 목적어로 명사구 a player’s ability가 이어지므로, 과거시제 능동태인 considered가 알맞다.

body:
Mathematics is beneficial in everyday life. We use math concepts and skills to understand patterns, define relationships, and ⓐ[predict / predicting] the future. You would be amazed to see the emergence of math in unexpected situations. Here are a few examples.
The Mathematics of Airplane Boarding
What is the most efficient way to board a plane? The standard procedure starts by boarding first class, then business class, and then economy class. In the case of economy class passengers, they are divided into blocks according to their seat rows to board. This often results in a crowded, chaotic situation for passengers. Mathematicians compared various boarding methods and found that boarding a plane starting from the front row took the longest while starting from the back row took the second longest.
From a mathematical point of view, the most efficient way appears to be seating passengers by the window, starting from the back. Then, passengers in the aisle seats board next, from back to front. This way, passengers can store their bags in the overhead bins almost simultaneously without disturbing each other. Further, since the boarding starts from the back, there is no need ⓑ[passengers / for passengers] to pass each other. Moreover, filling window seats first gets rid of the trouble ⓒ[of / that] aisle seat passengers having to stand up and move into the aisle while others take their seats. In short, (A)______.

윗글의 괄호 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
ⓐ ⓑ ⓒ
choices: predict / for passengers / of
predict / passengers / of
predict / for passengers / that
predicting / for passengers / of
predicting / passengers / that
solution:
ⓐ 목적(~하기 위해서)을 나타내는 부사적 용법의 to부정사구인 to understand 이하에서 to 뒤의 동사원형 understand, define과 ‘A, B, and C’ 구조로 병렬로 연결되어야 하므로, 동사원형 predict가 알맞다.
ⓑ 명사 need를 수식해 ‘there is no need+to부정사(~할 필요가 없다)’ 구문을 이루는 to부정사 to pass의 의미상 주어로 앞에 위치해야 하며, to부정사의 의미상 주어는 ‘for+목적격’ 형태로 나타내므로 for passengers가 알맞다. 참고로, 동명사의 의미상 주어는 동명사 앞에 목적격이나 소유격의 형태로 쓴다.
ⓒ 뒤에 목적격 형태의 의미상 주어인 명사구 aisle seat passengers와 동명사구 ‘having to ~ while others take their seats’가 연결되므로, 추상명사구 the trouble의 구체적 내용을 나타내는 동명사구를 연결하는 동격 전치사 of가 알맞다. 참고로, 추상명사(구)의 구체적인 내용에 해당하는 완전한 절을 연결할 때는 동격의 접속사 that이 쓰인다.

Passwords become difficult to hack when they are long and combine various characters. There can be 90²º combinations for a 20-digit password using around 90 letters, numbers, and special characters on a standard computer keyboard. However, there is a problem here as well. How will the user memorize this long password? Passwords should not be too easy but also not too complicated to memorize. (A) Using a passphrase with a story will make it easy to memorize, even if the phrase is long. (B) For example, if you use a passphrase like “mathfirstenglishlater,” which means that you will study math first and English later, it will be easy to memorize but difficult to hack. (C) Nevertheless, passphrases containing famous phrases or common combinations of words can still be vulnerable to security breaches. (D) You can make your password even more secure by adding capital letters and special characters. (E) For example, “mathfirst,Englishlater” is a very secure password.

다음 글의 (A)~(E) 중, 흐름상 관계없는 문장은?
solution: 길고 다양한 문자들을 결합한 비밀번호는 해킹하기 어렵지만 외우기가 어렵다는 문제를 제시한 뒤, 예시를 들어 이야기가 있는 암호를 사용하면 해킹하기 어려우면서도 긴 구문도 외우기 쉬워진다고 설명하고, 여기에 특수문자를 추가해 비밀번호를 더욱 안전하게 만들 수 있다는 흐름이므로, 이야기가 있는 암호가 가지는 단점을 언급한 (C) ‘그럼에도 불구하고, 유명한 문구나 흔한 단어 조합을 포함하는 암호는 여전히 보안 침해에 취약할 수 있다.’는 전체 글의 흐름과 관계없다.

In movies, hackers are often shown sitting in front of a computer, ⓐtried to figure out other people’s passwords. Is your password safe? That depends on how securely it was created. According to one survey, 26% of adults use passwords ⓑthat are easy to memorize, such as birthdays or names, and surprisingly, the most common passwords used were “123456,” “password,” “12345,” “12345678,” and “qwerty.”
The passwords used for mobile phones and banks ⓒbeing often four digits, and these are not very secure. Each digit can be selected from 10 numbers from 0 to 9, so there are 10⁴ possible codes. A computer can try all 10,000 combinations in the blink of an eye.
(A) ⓓUse a passphrase with a story will make it easy to memorize, even if the phrase is long. For example, if you use a passphrase like “mathfirstenglishlater,” which means that you will study math first and English later, it will be easy to memorize but difficult to hack. You can make your password even ⓔmore securely by adding capital letters and special characters. For example, “mathfirst,Englishlater” is a very secure password.
(B) Passwords become difficult to hack when they are long and combine various characters. There can be 90²º combinations for a 20-digit password using around 90 letters, numbers, and special characters on a standard computer keyboard. However, there is a problem here as well. How will the user memorize this long password? Passwords should not be too easy but also not too ⓕcomplicated to memorize.
(C) Let’s assume that, for security purposes, you create a password with six or more letters. Choosing a word with six or more letters as a password may be more secure. Six letters from the 26-letter alphabet ⓖmake a possible 26⁶ combinations, or more than 300 million total possibilities. It’s much better than a four-digit combination, though it’s still possible for a computer to check them all in only a few seconds.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓖ 중, 어법상 어색한 것의 개수는?
choices: 2개
3개
4개
5개
6개
solution:
어법상 어색한 것은 총 4개이다.
ⓐ tried → trying (앞의 완전한 절(hackers are often shown sitting in front of a computer)에 접속사 없이 콤마(,)로만 동사(구)가 연결될 수 없으므로 흐름상 앞의 ’sitting in front of a computer’에 연결되어 동시동작을 나타내는 분사구문을 이루는 분사 형태가 되어야 하며, 분사구문의 의미상 주어인 hackers가 비밀번호를 알아내려고 ‘노력하는’ 주체이므로, tried를 능동을 나타내는 현재분사 trying으로 고친다.)
ⓒ being → are (과거분사구 ‘used for mobile phones and banks’의 수식을 받는 주어 The passwords에 대한 동사가 필요하며, 문장이 일반적 사실을 나타내므로 현재시제를 사용해야 하고, 주어가 복수명사구이므로, being을 현재형이자 복수동사로 수일치한 are로 고친다.)
ⓓ Use → Using 또는 To use (문장의 동사구 will make에 대한 주어로 동명사구나 to부정사구를 이루어야 하므로, Use를 Using 또는 To use로 고친다.)
ⓔ more securely → more secure (make와 목적어 your password에 이어져 ‘make+목적어+목적격보어(~을 …하게[…한 상태로] 만들다)’의 5형식 구문을 이루는 목적격보어 자리이며, 보어로 부사는 쓸 수 없으므로, 부사의 비교급 more securely를 형용사의 비교급 more secure로 고친다.)

body:
Baseball is a game of statistics. It’s essential to know how many hits a batter can get and how many bases they can reach. Traditionally, batting average, which measures how often a player gets a hit, has been considered the most important criterion. However, in baseball, there is another way to reach first base besides a hit, and that’s a walk. Nevertheless, walks aren’t included in batting average, so players who don’t get many hits but are good at getting walks could be rated too ⓐ[high / low]. If players get on base in any way, they create scoring opportunities. (A)______, recent analyses have shown that on-base percentage is much more important for winning than batting averages.
A general manager of a professional baseball team in the United States, whose team could not afford to pay the biggest star players, created his own criteria for selecting players. His system valued how many bases a player averages per at-bat. It differed from the traditional batting average by ⓑ[reflecting / neglecting] not only the number of hits but also the types of hits (singles, doubles, triples, and home runs). It gave 1 point for singles, 2 points for doubles, 3 points for triples, and 4 points for home runs. Moreover, the system considered a player’s ability to draw walks as it contributes to getting on base and overall team success.
Using such standards, the team recruited valuable players other teams declined to pay. These players had low batting averages but excelled at drawing walks and had high on-base percentages. Despite having the third-lowest total player salary in the entire Major Leagues, the team ⓒ[reached / missed] the playoffs two years in a row, all thanks to this analytical approach.
(B)______, math is a subject that we use every day, from simple calculations to more complex problem-solving. It is a powerful tool that we need to navigate the world around us and to live efficiently and conveniently. Therefore, understanding basic math concepts is essential for making informed decisions.

윗글의 괄호 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
ⓐ ⓑ ⓒ
choices: high / reflecting / reached
low / reflecting / missed
low / neglecting / missed
high / neglecting / reached
low / reflecting / reached
solution:
ⓐ 야구에는 안타 외에도 1루에 진출하는 방법으로 볼넷이 있으나, 볼넷은 타율에 포함되지 않는다고 설명하므로, 안타를 많이 못 치지만 볼넷을 잘 얻는 선수들이 낮은 평가를 받을 수 있다는 흐름이 되는 low(낮은)가 알맞다.
ⓑ 미국의 한 프로야구팀 감독의 시스템은 전통적인 타율과 다르다고 언급하고 있으며, 이에 대해 뒤에서 단타는 1점, 2루타는 2점, 3루타에는 3점, 홈런에는 4점을 부과했다고 설명하므로, 안타의 수뿐만 아니라 안타의 유형까지 기준에 반영했다는 흐름이 되는 reflecting(~을 반영하는)이 알맞다.
ⓒ 팀의 감독이 자신만의 기준을 사용해 다른 팀들이 돈을 지급하기를 거절한 가치 있는 선수들을 영입했고, 그 선수들은 타율은 낮았지만 볼넷을 잘 얻고 출루율이 높았다고 설명하므로, 전체 메이저리그에서 세 번째로 낮은 총 선수 연봉을 가지고 있었음에도 불구하고 2년 연속 플레이오프에 진출했다는 흐름이 되는 reached(~에 도달했다)가 알맞다.

윗글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 알맞은 말로 연결된 것은?
(A) (B)
choices: Hence / To conclude
Therefore / Furthermore
For example / In conclusion
Nevertheless / In contrast
For instance / Conversely
solution:
(A) 선수들이 출루하면 어떤 식으로든 득점 기회를 만든다는 앞 내용을 근거로 최근의 분석 결과들은 출루율이 타율보다 승리에 더 중요하다는 것을 보여 주었다는 내용이 이어지므로, 인과관계를 나타내는 Hence(따라서) 또는 Therefore(그러므로)가 알맞다.
(B) 수학과 통계적 분석을 활용해 효과적으로 선수를 기용한 야구 팀 감독의 사례를 다룬 뒤, 수학은 우리가 매일 사용하는 과목이며, 주변 세계를 탐색하고 효율적이고 편리하게 생활하는 데 필요한 강력한 도구로서 현명한 의사 결정에 필수적이라고 결론을 짓고 있으므로, To conclude(마지막으로, 결론적으로 말하면) 또는 In conclusion(결론적으로)이 알맞다.

Riding a swift sleigh pulled by his friend Rudolph, Santa Claus begins a spectacular journey across the globe the day before Christmas, delivering presents such as dolls and toys to children everywhere. It’s a magical adventure that sparks our imaginations, but have you ever wondered just how fast Santa would need to travel to visit all the children in just one day? Let’s use some math to explore this interesting scenario.
It is obvious that Santa Claus, playing the role of a sleigh pilot in just one day, must deliver presents to children without skipping a single house. According to the United Nations’ 2022 World Population Prospects report, our world is home to approximately eight billion people, and among them, there are roughly two billion children under 14 years old. If we assume an average of two children per household, Santa would need to visit one billion households worldwide.
If we assume a simple distance of five meters between each house, Santa would have to cover a total distance of five billion meters, which amounts to five million kilometers. To accomplish this in one Christmas day, Santa’s noble mission remains a challenge, requiring a swift motion at a speed exceeding 200,000 kilometers per hour or approximately 58 kilometers per second. This is about 200 times faster than commercial airplanes typically fly.
Of course, it’s important to remember that this scenario ______. But from a mathematical perspective, it’s truly fascinating to visualize the extraordinary task that Santa Claus and Rudolph would have to undertake to make Christmas magical for children around the world. It’s a sophisticated reminder that the spirit of the holiday season exceeds the boundaries of time and space, bringing joy to countless hearts.

윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
choices: is mainly designed to explain the science of modern aviation
is a symbolic expression of the spirit of the holiday season
is increasingly realistic with modern transportation technology
is based on a realistic interpretation of Santa’s journey
is purely imaginary and impossible in the real world
solution: 정답은 ⑤ 이다. (해설 없음)

The passwords used for mobile phones and banks are often four digits, and these are not very secure. Each digit can be selected from 10 numbers from 0 to 9, so there are 10⁴ possible codes. A computer can try all 10,000 combinations ⓒin the blink of an eye. Let’s assume that, for security purposes, you create a password with six or more letters. Choosing a word with six or more letters as a password may be ⓓmore secure. Six letters from the 26-letter alphabet make a possible 26⁶ combinations, or more than 300 million total possibilities. It’s much better than a four-digit combination, though it’s still ⓔimpossible for a computer to check them all in only a few seconds.

solution: ⓔ impossible(불가능한) → possible(가능한)

body:
Baseball is a game of statistics. It’s essential to know how many hits a batter can get and how many bases they can reach. (A)전통적으로, 타율은 선수가 얼마나 자주 안타를 치는지를 측정하며, 가장 중요한 기준으로 여겨졌다. However, in baseball, there is another way to reach first base besides a hit, and that’s a walk. Nevertheless, walks aren’t included in batting average, so players who don’t get many hits but are good at getting walks could be rated too low. If players get on base in any way, they create scoring opportunities. Therefore, recent analyses have shown that (B)______ is much more important for winning than batting averages.
윗글의 빈칸 (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
choices: strikeout rate
home run rate
fielding percentage
earned run average
on-base percentage

Passwords become difficult to hack when they are long and ⓐcombining various characters. There can be 90²º combinations for a 20-digit password using around 90 letters, numbers, and special characters on a standard computer keyboard. However, there is a problem here as well. How will the user memorize this long password? Passwords should not be too easy but also not too complicated ⓑmemorizing.
Using a passphrase with a story will make it ⓒeasily to memorize, even if the phrase is long. For example, if you use a passphrase like “mathfirstenglishlater,” ⓓthat means that you will study math first and English later, it will be easy to memorize but difficult to hack. You can make your password ⓔvery more secure by adding capital letters and special characters. For example, “mathfirst,Englishlater” is a very secure password.

body:
Mathematics is beneficial in everyday life. We use math concepts and skills to understand patterns, define relationships, and predict the future. You would be (A)[amazing / amazed] to see the emergence of math in unexpected situations. Here are a few examples.
The Mathematics of Airplane Boarding
What is the most efficient way to (B)[board / boarding] a plane? The standard procedure starts by boarding first class, then business class, and then economy class. In the case of economy class passengers, they are divided into blocks according to their seat rows to board. This often ⓐ______. Mathematicians compared various boarding methods and found (C)[what / that] boarding a plane starting from the front row took the longest while starting from the back row took the second longest.
윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
(A) (B) (C)
choices: amazing board what
amazed board that
amazing boarding that
amazed boarding that
amazed board what
solution:
(A) would be에 이어진 주격 보어 자리이고, 주어 You가 ’놀라게 되는’ 대상이므로, 수동의 의미를 가진 과거분사 형태의 형용사 amazed가 알맞다.
(B) ’~하는 방법‘이라는 뜻으로 ’way+to부정사(구)‘를 사용하므로, to 뒤에 to부정사(to+동사원형)를 이루는 동사원형 board가 알맞다.
(C) 완전한 절(boarding ~ second longest)을 이끌어 동사 found의 목적어 역할을 하는 명사절을 이루고 있으므로 명사절 접속사 that이 알맞다.

(A)미국의 한 프로 야구팀 감독은 자신의 팀이 가장 유명한 스타 선수들에게 돈을 지불할 여유가 없었는데, 선수들을 선발하는 자신만의 기준을 만들었다. His system ⓐ[valued / overlooked] how many bases a player averages per at-bat. It differed from the traditional batting average by taking into account not only the number of hits but also the types of hits (singles, doubles, triples, and home runs). It gave 1 point for singles, 2 points for doubles, 3 points for triples, and 4 points for home runs. Moreover, the system considered a player’s ability to draw walks as it contributes to getting on base and overall team success.
Using such standards, the team recruited valuable players other teams ⓑ[consented / declined] to pay. These players had low batting averages but excelled at drawing walks and had high on-base percentages. Despite having the third-lowest total player salary in the entire Major Leagues, the team reached the playoffs two years in a row, all thanks to this analytical approach.
In conclusion, math is a subject that we use every day, from simple calculations to more complex problem-solving. It is a(n) ⓒ[powerful / outdated] tool that we need to navigate the world around us and to live efficiently and conveniently. Therefore, understanding basic math concepts is essential for making informed decisions.
윗글의 괄호 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
ⓐ ⓑ ⓒ
choices: valued consented powerful
valued declined outdated
valued declined powerful
overlooked consented outdated
overlooked declined powerful
solution:
ⓐ 전통적인 타율과 달리 안타의 수뿐만 아니라 단타, 2루타, 3루타, 홈런과 같은 안타의 유형까지 고려하여 각각 다른 점수를 부여하고, 나아가 볼넷을 얻는 능력까지 평가했다고 설명하고 있으므로, 선수가 한 타석당 평균 몇 루를 기록하는지를 중요하게 여겼다는 흐름이 되는 valued(~을 중요하게 여겼다, ~을 높이 평가했다)가 알맞다.
overlooked ~을 무시[간과]했다
ⓑ 영입한 선수들을 These players(이 선수들)로 가리켜 타율은 낮았지만 볼넷을 잘 얻고 출루율이 높았다고 설명하고, 이어서 전체 메이저리그에서 세 번째로 낮은 총 선수 연봉을 가지고 있었다고 언급하므로, 다른 팀들이 돈을 지불하려 하지 않았던 가치 있는 선수들이었다고 설명하는 흐름이 되는 declined(~을 거절했다)가 알맞다.
consented ~을 승낙했다
ⓒ 수학이 단순한 계산부터 더 복잡한 문제 해결까지 우리가 매일 사용하는 과목이라고 했으며, 마지막에는 기본적인 수학 개념을 이해하는 것이 현명한 결정을 내리는 데 필수적이라고 결론을 짓고 있으므로, 수학은 우리가 주변 세계를 탐색하고 효율적이고 편리하게 생활하는 데 필요한 강력한 도구라는 흐름이 되는 powerful(강력한, 영향력이 강한)이 알맞다.
outdated 구식의, 낡은

body:
Riding a swift sleigh pulled by his friend Rudolph, Santa Claus begins a spectacular journey across the globe the day before Christmas, delivering presents such as dolls and toys to children everywhere. It’s a magical adventure that sparks our imaginations, but have you ever wondered just how fast Santa would need to travel to visit all the children in just one day? Let’s use some math to explore this interesting scenario.
(A) Of course, it’s important to remember that this scenario is purely imaginary and impossible in the real world. But from a mathematical perspective, it’s truly fascinating to visualize the extraordinary task that Santa Claus and Rudolph would have to undertake to make Christmas magical for children around the world. It’s a sophisticated reminder that the spirit of the holiday season exceeds the boundaries of time and space, bringing joy to countless hearts.
(B) If we assume a simple distance of five meters between each house, Santa would have to cover a total distance of five billion meters, which amounts to five million kilometers. To accomplish this in one Christmas day, Santa’s noble mission remains a challenge, requiring a swift motion at a speed exceeding 200,000 kilometers per hour or approximately 58 kilometers per second. This is about 200 times faster than commercial airplanes typically fly.
(C) It is obvious that Santa Claus, playing the role of a sleigh pilot in just one day, must deliver presents to children without skipping a single house. According to the United Nations’ 2022 World Population Prospects report, our world is home to approximately eight billion people, and among them, there are roughly two billion children under 14 years old. If we assume an average of two children per household, Santa would need to visit one billion households worldwide.
위 주어진 글에 이어질 순서로 알맞은 것은?
solution: 산타클로스가 크리스마스 전날 전 세계 어린이들에게 선물을 전달하려면 얼마나 빠르게 이동해야 하는지 수학을 활용해 알아보자는 주어진 글 다음에, 수학적 문제를 구체적으로 계산하기 위한 기초 자료로 세계 인구와 어린이 수를 제시하고, 가구당 평균 두 명의 어린이가 있다고 가정하여 산타가 방문해야 할 가구를 약 10억 가구로 산출한 (C), 이어서 가구 간 거리를 가정하여 총 이동 거리와 하루 안에 이동하기 위해 필요한 속도를 계산한 (B), 앞서 가정한 수학적 시나리오를 this scenario(이 시나리오)로 받아, 이러한 시나리오가 상상에 기반한 것이지만 수학적 관점에서 산타의 비범한 임무를 생각해 보는 것이 매혹적이며, 연휴 시즌의 분위기가 시공간의 경계를 초월해 수많은 마음에 기쁨을 가져다준다는 것을 세련된 방식으로 상기시켜 주는 것이라고 마무리하는 (A)로 이어지는 것이 알맞다.

However, there is a (B)[problem / benefit] here as well. How will the user memorize this long password? Passwords should not be too easy but also not too complicated to memorize.

Using a passphrase with a story will make it easy to memorize, even if the phrase is long. For example, if you use a passphrase like “mathfirstenglishlater,” which means that you will study math first and English later, it will be easy to memorize but difficult to hack. You can make your password even more secure by (C)[deleting / adding] capital letters and special characters. For example, “mathfirst,Englishlater” is a very secure password.

다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
choices: lack / problem / deleting
combine / benefit / adding
combine / problem / adding
lack / benefit / adding
combine / problem / deleting
solution:
(A) 표준 컴퓨터 키보드에 있는 약 90개의 문자, 숫자 및 특수문자를 사용하면 20자리 비밀번호의 조합은 90²º개가 될 수 있다는 설명이 이어지므로, 비밀번호가 길고 다양한 문자를 결합할 때 해킹하기 어려워진다는 흐름이 되는 combine(~을 결합하다)이 알맞다.
(B) 이어지는 문장에서 사용자가 긴 비밀번호를 어떻게 외울 것인가라는 문제를 제시하며, 비밀번호는 너무 쉽지도, 외우기 너무 복잡하지도 않아야 한다고 설명하므로, 긴 비밀번호에 문제가 있다는 흐름이 되는 problem(문제)이 알맞다.
(C) 이야기를 활용하면 구문이 길더라도 외우기 쉽다고 하면서 예시로 “mathfirstenglishlater”를 제시한 뒤, 여기에 대문자와 특수문자를 사용한 “mathfirst,Englishlater”를 또 다시 예로 들어 매우 안전한 비밀번호라고 말하므로, 이야기가 있는 암호에 대문자와 특수문자를 추가하여 비밀번호를 더욱 안전하게 만들 수 있다는 흐름이 되는 adding(추가함)이 알맞다.

body:
Baseball is a game of statistics. It’s essential to know how many hits a batter can get and how many bases they can reach. Traditionally, batting average, which measures how often a player gets a hit, ⓐhas considered the most important criterion. However, in baseball, there is another way to reach first base besides a hit, and ㉠that’s a walk. (A)______, walks aren’t included in batting average, so players who don’t get many hits but ⓑare good at getting walks could be rated too low. If players get on base in any way, they create scoring opportunities. Therefore, recent analyses have shown ⓒthat on-base percentage is much more important for winning than batting averages.

A general manager of a professional baseball team in the United States, ⓓwhose team could not afford to pay the biggest star players, created his own criteria for selecting players. His system valued how many bases a player averages per at-bat. It differed from the traditional batting average by ⓔbeing taken into account not only the number of hits but also the types of hits (singles, doubles, triples, and home runs). It gave 1 point for singles, 2 points for doubles, 3 points for triples, and 4 points for home runs. (B)______, the system considered a player’s ability to draw walks as ㉡it contributes ⓕto get on base and overall team success.

윗글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 알맞은 말로 연결된 것은?
choices: Therefore / In fact
As a result / In short
For example / Moreover
Nevertheless / However
Nonetheless / Furthermore
solution:
(A) 전통적으로 선수가 얼마나 자주 안타를 치는지를 측정하는 타율이 가장 중요한 기준이었다는 내용 뒤에 야구에는 안타 외에도 볼넷과 같이 1루에 진출하는 방법이 있다는 내용으로 흐름이 반전되므로, ‘그럼에도 불구하고’를 뜻하는 Nevertheless 또는 Nonetheless가 알맞다.
(B) 감독의 시스템은 선수가 한 타석당 평균 몇 루를 기록하는지를 평가했다는 내용과 그에 대한 구체적 설명 뒤에, 이 시스템은 선수가 볼넷을 얻는 능력도 고려했다는 또 다른 기준을 추가 제시하므로, ‘게다가(더욱이)’를 뜻하는 Moreover 또는 Furthermore가 알맞다.

body:
A general manager of a professional baseball team in the United States, whose team could not afford to pay the biggest star players, (A)[created / abandoned] his own criteria for selecting players. His system valued how many bases a player averages per at-bat. It differed from the traditional batting average by taking into account not only the number of hits but also the types of hits (singles, doubles, triples, and home runs). It gave 1 point for singles, 2 points for doubles, 3 points for triples, and 4 points for home runs. Moreover, the system considered a player’s ability to draw walks as it contributes to getting on base and overall team success.

Using such standards, the team recruited valuable players other teams declined to pay. These players had low batting averages but excelled at drawing walks and had high on-base percentages. Despite having the third-lowest total player salary in the entire Major Leagues, the team reached the playoffs two years in a row, all thanks to this (B)[intuitive / analytical] approach.

In conclusion, math is a subject that we use every day, from simple calculations to more complex problem-solving. It is a powerful tool that we need to navigate the world around us and to live efficiently and conveniently. Therefore, understanding basic math concepts is (C)[essential / inessential] for making informed decisions.

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
choices: abandoned / intuitive / essential
created / analytical / essential
created / intuitive / inessential
created / analytical / inessential
abandoned / analytical / essential
solution:
(A) 그의 시스템은 선수가 한 타석당 평균 몇 루를 기록하는지를 평가했고 이는 안타의 수뿐만 아니라 안타의 유형까지 고려해 전통적인 타율과 달랐다는 설명이 이어지므로, 미국의 한 프로 야구팀 감독이 기존의 방식과 다른 자신만의 선수 선발 기준을 만들었다는 흐름이 되는 created(~을 만들었다)가 알맞다.
(B) 선수가 한 타석당 평균 몇 루를 기록하는지를 평가하고, 안타의 유형을 고려해 각 유형에 각기 다른 점수를 부여하는 등 수학적 분석을 바탕으로 한 기준을 사용해 선수들을 영입했고, 그 결과 팀이 2년 연속 플레이오프에 진출했으므로, 그러한 성공이 모두 분석적 접근 덕분이었다고 설명하는 흐름이 되는 analytical(분석적인)이 알맞다.
(C) 수학은 우리가 주변 세계를 탐색하고 효율적이고 편리하게 생활하는 데 필요한 강력한 도구라는 설명 뒤에 이어지므로, 기본적인 수학 개념을 이해하는 것은 현명한 결정을 내리는 데 필수적이라고 결론짓는 흐름이 되는 essential(필수적인)이 알맞다.

body:
Riding a swift sleigh ⓐpulled by his friend Rudolph, Santa Claus begins a (A)spectacular journey across the globe the day before Christmas, delivering presents such as dolls and toys to children everywhere. It’s a magical adventure that (B)sparks our imaginations, but have you ever wondered just how fast Santa would need to travel ⓑto visit all the children in just one day? Let’s use some math to explore this interesting scenario.

It is obvious ⓒwhat Santa Claus, playing the role of a sleigh pilot in just one day, must deliver presents to children without (C)dropping in a single house. According to the United Nations’ 2022 World Population Prospects report, our world is home to approximately eight billion people, and among them, there are roughly two billion children under 14 years old. If we assume an average of two children per household, Santa would need to visit one billion households worldwide.

If we assume a simple distance of five meters between each house, Santa would have to (D)cover a total distance of five billion meters, which ⓓamounts to five million kilometers. To accomplish this in one Christmas day, Santa’s noble mission remains a challenge, ⓔrequires a swift motion at a speed (E)exceeding 200,000 kilometers per hour or approximately 58 kilometers per second. This is about 200 times faster than commercial airplanes typically fly.

Of course, it’s important to remember that this scenario is purely imaginary and impossible in the real world. (F)그러나 수학적인 관점에서 볼 때, 세계 모든 어린이에게 마법 같은 크리스마스를 만들기 위해 산타클로스와 루돌프가 맡을 비범한 과업을 상상하는 것은 정말로 매혹적이다. It’s a sophisticated reminder ⓕwhich the spirit of the holiday season exceeds the boundaries of time and space, bringing joy to countless hearts.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ 중, 어법상 알맞은 것의 개수는?
choices: 1개
2개
3개
4개
5개
solution:
어법상 알맞은 것은 총 3개이다.
ⓐ 흐름상 앞의 명사구 a swift sleigh를 수식하는 분사구를 이루는 분사가 올 수 있으며, 수식받는 명사구가 ‘끌리는’ 대상이고 뒤에 목적어 없이 행위 주체를 나타내는 ‘by+명사구’가 이어져 있으므로, 수동을 나타내는 과거분사 pulled는 알맞다.
ⓑ 앞의 동사구 would need to travel에 흐름상 ‘방문하기 위해’라는 뜻으로 이어져야 하므로, 목적(~하기 위해)을 나타내는 부사적 용법의 to부정사인 to visit은 알맞다.
ⓓ 콤마(,) 뒤에 쓰인 계속적 용법의 주격 관계대명사 which가 이끄는 절의 동사 자리이며, 관계사절이 부연 설명하는 선행사 a total distance of six billion meters가 단수명사구이므로, 단수동사로 수일치한 amounts는 알맞다. 참고로, 자동사 amount와 전치사 to가 함께 쓰인 ’amount to ~’는 ‘(총계가) ~에 달하다’라는 뜻을 나타낸다.

body:
What is the most efficient way to board a plane? The standard procedure starts by boarding first class, then business class, and then economy class. In the case of economy class passengers, they are divided into blocks according to their seat rows to board. This often results in a crowded, chaotic situation for passengers. Mathematicians compared various boarding methods and (A)[found / finding] that boarding a plane starting from the front row took the longest while starting from the back row took the second longest.

From a mathematical point of view, the most efficient way appears to be seating passengers by the window, starting from the back. Then, passengers in the aisle seats board next, from back to front. This way, passengers can store their bags in the overhead bins almost simultaneously without (B)[disturbing / being disturbed] each other. Further, since the boarding starts from the back, there is no need for passengers to pass each other. ⓐ더욱이, 창가 좌석을 먼저 채우는 것은 복도 좌석 승객들이 다른 사람들이 착석하는 동안 일어나서 복도로 이동해야 하는 번거로움을 없애준다. In short, the most efficient way is to start with window seat passengers and (C)[moving / to move] from back to front.

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
choices: finding / disturbing / moving
finding / being disturbed / to move
found / disturbing / moving
found / disturbing / to move
found / being disturbed / to move
solution:
(A) 주어 Mathematicians에 대한 과거동사 compared와 등위접속사 and에 의해 병렬로 연결되어야 하므로, 과거동사 found가 알맞다.
(B) 의미상 주어 passengers가 ‘방해하는’ 주체이며, 뒤에 목적어로 명사구 each other가 있으므로, 능동형 동명사 disturbing이 알맞다.
(C) is의 보어 자리에 쓰인 to부정사 to start와 등위접속사 and에 의해 병렬로 연결되므로, to부정사인 to move가 알맞다.
